title: Global Audit Manager Partner Business
description:
**Dear Aspirant!**

**We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.**

**We are looking for: Supplier Quality Engineer - Global Audit Manager Partner Business**

**You’ll make an impact by:**

**AI Strategy and Architecture.**

* Plan, prepare, and conduct remote partner inspections in accordance with defined quality and audit standards (e.g., VDA 6.3, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 27001), including documentation of objective evidence.
* Perform document-based evaluations, deep-dive assessments, and remote factory tours covering.
* Manufacturing and process flows, Product quality and process stability
* EHS compliance, Workplace organization and 5S implementation
* Risk and maturity assessment, Ensure all required partner documentation (Quality, EHS, Cybersecurity, Social Responsibility, process documentation, and compliance records) is complete, reviewed, and compliant prior to approval.
* Lead inspection kick-off meetings with global partners, aligning scope, expectations, timelines, and responsibilities.
* Partner Governance: Assess partner maturity, capabilities, risks, and compliance against defined qualification criteria and document results in a structured and traceable manner.
* Decide on inspection readiness and release partners only after all defined quality, compliance, and business requirements have been fulfilled.
* Support the qualification, monitoring, requalification, and governance of partners throughout their lifecycle.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Inspection Coordination:
* Coordinate with Sales, EHS, Regional Organizations, and Partner Quality responsible in HQ to support partner qualification activities worldwide.
* Enable and support HQ / Regional inspection responsible in planning and executing on-site inspections where required.
* Organize and align remote inspection schedules with partners, and internal stakeholders globally across multiple time zones.
* Corrective Actions, Reporting & Continuous Improvement:
* Track, validate, and monitor corrective actions with partners until effective and sustainable closure is achieved.
* Create and maintain inspection reports, management summaries, and performance reviews.
* Finalize inspection reports including findings, action plans, conclusions, and approvals, and communicate results professionally to internal and external stakeholders.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of remote inspection methodologies, qualification processes, checklists, standards, and governance models.
* Ensure transparency, consistency, and compliance across all partner inspections activities globally.

**Use your skills to move the world forward!**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline.
* 5+ years of professional experience in Supplier Quality Management, Quality Management, Quality Assurance, Auditing, Manufacturing, or Operations.
* Proven experience conducting process audits, product audits, supplier audits, preferably including remote audits.
* Knowledge of medium-voltage products and manufacturing processes.
* Technical Expertise
* Knowledge of management system standards: ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 27001, VDA 6.3.
* Manufacturing and industrial processes, Product and process quality assurance
* EHS requirements and risk assessment, 5S and Lean principles
* Corrective and preventive action management, KPI-based performance monitoring
* Auditor certification and social audit knowledge are considered advantageous.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess partner maturity, risks, and compliance in a global environment.
* Excellent documentation, reporting, and evidence-based decision-making skills.
* Highly structured and organized working style with the ability to manage multiple inspections, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills in an international environment.
* Experience working within interdisciplinary, global, and cross-functional networks.
* High intercultural awareness and sensitivity when collaborating with partners of varying maturity levels and cultural backgrounds.
* High degree of ownership, reliability, execution strength, and accountability.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.

**Create a better #TomorrowWithUs!**

This role is based in Chennai, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries - and the shape of things to come.

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

1. Job Summary  
We are looking for a creative and technically skilled eLearning Design & Development Specialist to develop engaging, interactive, and visually appealing digital learning solutions.  
The candidate should have a strong understanding of eLearning design and development, instructional design principles, multimedia development, video editing, animation, and emerging AI technologies.  
The role involves working closely with instructional designers, subject matter experts, and project teams to transform learning content into engaging digital learning experiences using authoring tools, creative software, video production tools, and AI assisted workflows.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

2. Key Responsibilities  
  
A. eLearning Design & Development  
  
. Design and develop engaging, interactive, and visually appealing eLearning courses.  
. Develop eLearning modules using Articulate Storyline 360 and Rise 360.  
. Convert learning content, storyboards, and scripts into interactive digital learning experiences.  
. Create engaging screen layouts, templates, navigation, interactions, and assessments.  
. Develop knowledge checks, quizzes, scenarios, and interactive learning activities.  
. Apply instructional design principles to improve learner engagement and knowledge retention.  
. Ensure consistency in visual design, typography, layouts, and user experience.  
. Collaborate with instructional designers and subject matter experts to understand learning requirements.  
. Conduct functional testing and review eLearning courses before publishing.  
. Publish and package courses in SCORM format and support LMS compatibility testing.  
  
  
B. Visual Design & Multimedia Development  
  
. Create illustrations, icons, infographics, process diagrams, flowcharts, and data visualizations for eLearning courses.  
. Design visual assets, banners, backgrounds, and other multimedia elements.  
. Develop creative concepts and visual treatments based on learning requirements.  
. Ensure consistency in branding, colour schemes, typography, and visual hierarchy.  
. Optimize graphics and multimedia assets for digital learning platforms.  
. Apply basic UI/UX design principles to improve the overall learner experience.  
  
  
C. Video Development & Animation  
  
. Develop engaging learning videos, explainer videos, and corporate training videos.  
. Create 2D animations, character animations, and animated explainer videos using Vyond.  
. Develop video storyboards, visual concepts, and scene layouts based on scripts and project requirements.  
. Work with voiceovers, background music, subtitles, and on screen text to create professional video content.  
. Edit and assemble video content using Adobe Premiere Pro or other video editing tools.  
. Create motion graphics, transitions, and visual effects using Adobe After Effects.  
. Synchronize voiceovers with animations and video content.  
. Develop software demonstration videos and screen recorded tutorials.  
. Optimize video assets for different learning platforms and delivery requirements.  
. Incorporate client feedback and make necessary revisions to video and animation content.  
  
  
D. AI Assisted Instructional Design & Content Development  
  
. Use Generative AI tools to support instructional design, content structuring, and eLearning storyboard development.  
. Leverage AI tools to generate learning objectives, assessment questions, knowledge checks, and scenario based learning content.  
. Use AI tools to review, refine, simplify, and improve learning content.  
. Generate ideas for interactive learning activities and learner engagement.  
. Explore AI assisted solutions for content transformation, instructional design, and learning development.  
. Use AI tools to improve content quality, productivity, and development efficiency.  
  
  
E. AI Assisted Visual Design & Video Production  
  
. Utilize AI tools to generate creative concepts, visual references, illustrations, icons, and design assets.  
. Explore AI powered image generation and editing tools to enhance eLearning visuals.  
. Use AI assisted tools for video scripting, storyboarding, animation concepts, and video production.  
. Explore AI powered voiceover generation, text to speech, subtitle creation, and audio enhancement.  
. Leverage AI tools to streamline creative workflows and reduce production time.  
. Stay updated with emerging Generative AI tools and identify opportunities to integrate them into digital learning and multimedia development.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

3. Required Skills & Qualifications  
  
. 2–4 years of experience in eLearning design and development or digital learning development.  
. Hands on experience with Articulate Storyline 360 and Rise 360.  
. Strong knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.  
. Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects.  
. Hands on experience with Vyond for 2D animation and explainer video development.  
. Good understanding of instructional design principles and eLearning development methodologies.  
. Ability to create interactive learning experiences, assessments, and multimedia content.  
. Strong understanding of visual design, typography, colour theory, and layout principles.  
. Experience with video editing, animation, and multimedia production.  
. Familiarity with Generative AI tools for content development, instructional design, and visual creation.  
. Basic understanding of SCORM publishing and LMS compatibility.

The discipline translates business and technical requirements into reliable applications, services, interfaces and digital capabilities that can be safely operated, enhanced and scaled over time.

The discipline requires strong programming capability, sound engineering judgement, collaboration across technology and business teams, and the ability to balance speed of delivery with quality, security, reliability and long-term sustainability.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Design & Application Development**  
• Design and build software applications, interfaces, APIs and services that meet business requirements while remaining secure, scalable, maintainable and performant.

**• Simplify and refactor systems, code and workflows to reduce complexity, improve performance and address technical debt.**  
**• Apply lessons learned from defects, incidents, reviews and delivery challenges to improve future engineering outcomes.**

title: AI Implement Engineer
description:
**Location:** Thiruvallur / Chennai  
**Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related engineering field.**

**Experience:** 2 to 3 Years

An **AI Implement Engineer** in **Municipal Solid Waste Management (MSWM)** designs, deploys, and maintains artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions across the entire urban waste lifecycle—from generation and smart collection to automated sorting and disposal. The **AI Implement Engineer** bridges the gap between artificial intelligence, Management operations, and waste-to-resource management systems. This role is responsible for designing, deploying, and managing AI-driven workflows.

· Design, deploy, and scale machine learning (ML) models, computer vision systems, and optimization algorithms tailored to manufacturing floors and waste-sorting/processing plants.

· Integrate AI models with existing Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and IoT sensor networks (MQTT, OPC UA).

· Build real-time monitoring dashboards and automated alert systems for resource utilization, emissions tracking, connecting the software for real time implementation.

**Core Responsibilities**

· **Smart Collection & IoT Integration:** Deploy and manage IoT sensor networks in smart bins to track fill levels in real time, using predictive models (such as Artificial Neural Networks or Support Vector Machines) to forecast waste accumulation.

· **Route & Fleet Optimization:** Build and maintain Genetic Algorithms and GIS (Geographic Information Systems) routing engines to minimize fuel consumption, travel distances, and greenhouse gas emissions for garbage trucks.]

· **Automated Sorting & Computer Vision:** Implement computer vision models (such as YOLO variants and deep convolutional neural networks) alongside robotic arms or optical sorters to classify materials (plastics, paper, organic) at high precision.

· **Contamination Detection:** Set up edge-computing vision systems (such as on-truck camera arrays) to spot improper sorting or hazardous items before bins are emptied into compaction trucks

· **Data Pipelines & Digital Twins:** Create scalable data infrastructure for municipal waste data, training machine learning models to forecast city-wide waste volumes and model circular economy outcomes.

title: Cyber - Data Protection- Databricks Security - Senior Consultant
description:
Join Deloitte Cyber's Data and Digital Trust practice as a Senior Engineering Management Specialist and help clients secure Databricks Lakehouse environments. You will assess security posture, implement governance and access controls, and integrate security capabilities across cloud data platforms. You will collaborate with client, delivery, and vendor teams to deliver practical solutions that support privacy, regulatory, and business objectives.

**Work you'll do**

As a Senior Engineering Management Specialist on the Data and Digital Trust team, you will be responsible for:

* Assess Databricks Lakehouse environments, including workspaces, Unity Catalog, clusters, SQL warehouses, notebooks, jobs, and data pipelines; identify security and regulatory gaps; and prioritize remediation.
* Design and implement data governance and access-control models using Unity Catalog, including metastores, catalogs, schemas, grants, row filters, column masks, and attribute-based access controls.
* Configure platform, network, and identity controls, including private connectivity, secure cluster connectivity, Internet Protocol (IP) access lists, cluster policies, secrets management, customer-managed encryption keys, single sign-on (SSO), System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) provisioning, and least-privilege access.
* Implement data classification, tagging, lineage, masking, tokenization, Delta Sharing, clean rooms, and cross-cloud or cross-workspace access for sensitive data.
* Enable audit logging and monitoring; integrate Databricks with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR), and cloud security tools; evaluate complementary governance tools; and create architecture and operational documentation with client, delivery, and vendor teams.

**The team**

Data and Digital Trust practice is primarily focused on helping our clients to utilize effective data while safeguarding privacy and security. D&DT solutions prioritize transparency, privacy, and the ethical use of data, assisting organizations in driving sustainable digital transformation. Our solutions assist organizations in meeting the shifting expectations of consumers and create unprecedented business opportunities. We help our clients to define their overall Data protection and Privacy strategy, design global pan-enterprise programs that focus on mitigating threats, evaluate their objectives, priorities, strengths and weaknesses and roll out large scale organizational changes to achieve goals. Our services capture work across advice, implement, and operate solutions. The Data and Digital Trust team delivers services to clients through following key areas:

* Privacy Governance & Compliance
* Data Protection & Compliance
* Digital Trust & Online Protection
* Risk & Controls Enablement
* Technology & Implementation

Our Data and Digital Trust solutions are designed to allow organizations to address requirements stemming from the ever-changing regulatory landscape, consumer expectations, and technological transformations and advancements.

**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**

**Shift Timings: General shift**

**Qualifications**

Required:

* 5–8 years of experience in data security, data protection, or cloud security, including 2+ years securing Databricks environments.
* Experience configuring Databricks security features, including Unity Catalog, access controls, secrets, cluster policies, audit logs, and encryption.
* Experience implementing data classification, masking, and fine-grained access controls in a Lakehouse or big-data environment.
* Experience with data and network security controls in Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience using Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), and infrastructure as code with Terraform to automate security configurations.
* Experience integrating Databricks with identity platforms and Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tools, and creating technical documentation or delivering client training.
* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent

Preferred:

* Experience with Cyera, Immuta, Privacera, Collibra, BigID, Securiti.ai, or Microsoft Purview.
* Experience with Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Delta Sharing, or artificial intelligence and machine learning workload security using MLflow, model serving, or Mosaic AI.
* One or more of the following: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Professional certification; Databricks Platform Administrator accreditation; Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA); Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP); Certified Information Security Manager (CISM); Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP); or a cloud security certification from AWS, Azure, or GCP.

* Develop hypothesis-driven threat hunts using SIEM, EDR/XDR, firewall, DNS, proxy, authentication, and vulnerability data; document evidence, conclusions, and follow-up actions.
* Engineer, tune, and validate detections to improve fidelity, reduce false positives, and map coverage to MITRE ATT&CK techniques.
* Build investigation workflows and queries for suspicious authentication, lateral movement, command execution, persistence, data staging, beaconing, and exfiltration behaviors.
* Perform incident command or technical-lead duties for major events and coordinate evidence preservation, containment, recovery, and post-incident improvements.
* Must have good experience in using LLM’s for security posture improvements.
  

**Network, Endpoint & Identity Security**

* Provide senior technical support for firewalls, IPS/IDS, endpoint protection, EDR/XDR, secure remote access, network security monitoring, and security analytics platforms.
* Review network security policies and security profiles using least privilege, risk, business context, and change-control requirements.
* Investigate anomalous remote access, privileged activity, service-account use, account lifecycle events, and unusual east-west or outbound traffic.
* Partner with infrastructure and platform teams to validate remediation, compensating controls, and residual risk.
  

**Application Security & Penetration Testing**

* Plan and execute authorized penetration tests of web applications, APIs, and supporting infrastructure; define scope, rules of engagement, evidence handling, and retest criteria.
* Assess common application and API weaknesses using OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, threat modeling, secure design review, and manual testing techniques.
* Advise product and engineering teams on practical placement and use of SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, secrets scanning, container scanning, and infrastructure-as-code scanning within the SDLC.
* Validate exploitability, business impact, attack paths, and remediation effectiveness; produce clear technical findings and executive summaries.
* Facilitate threat-modeling sessions covering assets, trust boundaries, abuse cases, security controls, and residual risks before significant releases or architectural changes.

  

**Vulnerability & Exposure Management**

* Lead risk-based prioritization using exploitability, asset criticality, internet exposure, active exploitation, compensating controls, and business impact rather than severity score alone.
* Coordinate remediation and exception workflows with asset owners; validate closure through rescanning, configuration review, or technical retesting.
* Analyze recurring weaknesses and control gaps, and recommend preventive actions across configuration, patching, architecture, and secure development practices.

  

**Automation, Engineering & Operational Excellence**

* Automate repeatable analysis, enrichment, reporting, and response activities using scripting, APIs, SOAR, reusable templates, and version-controlled content.
* Maintain runbooks, detection documentation, architecture diagrams, integration details, operational procedures, and knowledge-transfer materials.
* Define meaningful operational measures for detection coverage, investigation quality, response, remediation ageing, recurrence, and control effectiveness.
* Evaluate security tooling and integrations through structured testing, operational fit, telemetry quality, scalability, and maintainability.
  

**Technical Leadership & Representation**

* Act as a technical delegate for the Manager – Security Operations in operational reviews, incident forums, architecture discussions, audits, and cross-functional meetings.
* Provide clear risk-based recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders without overstating certainty or impact.
* Mentor analysts and engineers through case reviews, hunt development, detection engineering, application security, and incident-response exercises.
* Coordinate effectively across regions and time zones and participate in the 24x7 on-call rotation as required.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience with SentinelOne or a comparable EDR/XDR platform; Splunk or a comparable SIEM; Fortinet/FortiGate/FortiAnalyzer or comparable network security technologies; and enterprise vulnerability-management platforms.
* Experience securing cloud, container, Kubernetes, DevSecOps, and infrastructure-as-code environments.
* Experience conducting forensic analysis, purple-team exercises, attack-path analysis, or adversary emulation in authorized environments.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GIAC (GCIH, GCIA, GPEN), OSCP/OSWE, CREST, or cloud-security certifications. Certifications are valued as supporting evidence, not a substitute for demonstrated hands-on capability.
* Experience supporting globally distributed teams and regulated or high-availability environments.
  

**Education And/Or Qualification:**

* 13 to 15 years of progressive cybersecurity or closely related engineering experience, including at least 5 years in security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or threat hunting.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience leading complex security investigations and communicating evidence, risk, decisions, and remediation actions.
* Practical experience with SIEM and EDR/XDR platforms, firewall or network security telemetry, identity and authentication logs, vulnerability scanners, and ticket or case-management workflows.
* Hands-on web application and API penetration-testing experience, including manual validation and clear reporting of reproducible findings.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, TLS, authentication, Windows and Linux security, Active Directory or modern identity platforms, and cloud security fundamentals.
* Experience with vulnerability and exposure management, risk-based prioritization, remediation validation, and exception governance.
* Working knowledge of secure SDLC controls, SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, secrets management, threat modeling, and CI/CD security integration.
* Proficiency in at least one scripting or query language used for security analysis or automation, such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, SPL, KQL, SQL, or a platform-specific query language.
* Ability to lead technical discussions, mentor team members, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively during high-pressure incidents.
* Must have experience in effectively using AI models for Security operations and security posture development.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, including executive-ready summaries and technically precise documentation.

  

**Leadership Behaviors**

* Hands-on ownership: moves from alert or finding to evidence-based conclusion and verified remediation.
* Judgment: distinguishes true risk from technical noise and makes proportionate recommendations.
* Collaboration: challenges constructively, listens to operational constraints, and builds agreement around secure outcomes.
* Communication: adapts depth and language for analysts, engineers, product teams, auditors, and executives.
* Learning mindset: stays current, tests assumptions, shares knowledge, and continuously improves controls and team capability.
  

**Interview Evidence to Validate**

Candidates should be assessed through practical evidence rather than tool-name familiarity alone. The interview process should validate:

* A structured investigation of a multi-source security incident using endpoint, firewall, identity, DNS, and application evidence.
* A threat-hunting scenario requiring a hypothesis, queries, exclusions, validation steps, and a defensible conclusion.
* A web application or API security scenario covering attack surface, testing approach, exploitability, remediation, and retesting.
* A detection-tuning exercise that balances coverage, false positives, and operational impact.
* An example of leading remediation across teams when ownership, business impact, or exception requirements are contested.
* Ability to brief the same issue to both engineers and senior leadership.
  

**Work Requirements**

* Participate in an on-call rotation and perform after-hours work when required for major incidents, critical changes, or global operational needs.
* Comply with applicable HID Global policies and procedures related to quality, security, safety, business continuity, privacy, and environmental systems.
* Perform only formally authorized security testing and follow approved scope, evidence-handling, and disclosure requirements.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the role.
  

**Document note:** This revision positions the role as a senior hands-on lead with balanced depth across SOC operations, threat hunting, incident response, network and identity security, vulnerability management, application security, penetration testing, automation, and stakeholder representation.

  

**Why apply?**

* **Empowerment:** You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. This opportunity may be open to flexible working arrangements.

On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. title: Sr. Major Incident Management Engineer - ROPS
description:
Job Title: ITSM Service Manager

  
  

Location: Chennai, TN.

  
  

Employment Type: Full-Time / Contract

  
  

About the Role

  
  

The ITSM Service Manager is primarily responsible for the strategic design, implementation, and continual improvement of IT Service Management (ITSM) processes across the enterprise. Acting as the champion of ITIL best practices, this role ensures IT services meet agreed-upon Service Level Agreements (SLAs), governs the ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow), and drives a culture of high-quality, customer-centric IT support.

  
  

As an additional core responsibility, this role provides operational oversight to the Network Operations Center (NOC). By integrating ITSM governance directly with NOC operations, the manager will ensure that event monitoring, alert tuning, and Tier 1/2 escalation workflows perfectly align with the organization's broader Incident, Problem, and Change Management frameworks.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

  
  

1. ITSM Process Governance & Strategy (Primary)

  
  

Process Ownership: Serve as the enterprise process owner for Incident, Problem, Change, Release, Request, and Knowledge Management.

  
  

Continual Service Improvement (CSI): Analyze existing IT workflows, identify bottlenecks, and implement data-driven process improvements.

  
  

Platform Optimization: Partner with ITSM developers to ensure the platform (e.g., ServiceNow) is optimized, automated, and accurately reflects process requirements.

  
  

Service Catalog & CMDB: Maintain the IT Service Catalog and oversee Configuration Management Database (CMDB) accuracy, ensuring CI dependencies are mapped for accurate impact analysis.

  
  

2. Major Incident, Problem & Change Leadership (Primary)

  
  

Major Incident Commander: Act as the ultimate escalation point for Severity 1/2 incidents. Coordinate cross-functional technical teams (including the NOC) to restore services rapidly, managing war rooms and executive communications.

  
  

Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Drive the Problem Management lifecycle by ensuring post-incident reviews (PIRs) are completed and permanent fixes are tracked and implemented.

  
  

Change Advisory Board (CAB): Chair the CAB, rigorously evaluating the risk, impact, and operational readiness of all proposed infrastructure and application changes.

  
  

3. Service Level & Performance Management (Primary)

  
  

SLA/OLA Management: Negotiate and enforce Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with business units and Operational Level Agreements (OLAs) between support tiers.

  
  

Metrics & Dashboards: Design and publish executive reporting on ITSM and IT operations KPIs (e.g., Mean Time to Resolve [MTTR], First Contact Resolution [FCR], Change Success Rate).

  
  

Vendor Governance: Monitor third-party managed service providers and software vendors to ensure compliance with contracted SLAs.

  
  

4. NOC Oversight & Event Management (Additional)

  
  

Operational Alignment: Oversee the NOC's daily operations to ensure monitoring, event detection, and initial triage strictly adhere to defined ITSM processes.

  
  

Alert-to-Incident Workflow: Guide the tuning of enterprise monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Datadog) to reduce alert noise and automate incident creation for actionable events.

  
  

Escalation Pathways: Develop and maintain runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and escalation matrices for the NOC to ensure seamless handoffs to Tier 3 engineering.

  
  

Team Guidance: Provide matrix leadership or direct oversight to NOC shift leads, ensuring 24/7 coverage maintains high standards of responsiveness and communication.

  
  

Qualifications & Experience

  
  

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field.

  
  

Experience: 6 to 8+ years of progressive experience in IT Operations, with a minimum of 4 years dedicated to ITSM process ownership or service delivery. Includes at least 2 years of experience overseeing, interacting with, or managing a NOC/Command Center environment.

  
  

ITSM Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience managing enterprise ITSM platforms (ServiceNow strongly preferred; Cherwell, Jira Service Management, or BMC Helix accepted).

  
  

Monitoring Acumen: Familiarity with enterprise monitoring concepts and ITOM tools (e.g., Splunk, Datadog, SolarWinds, LogicMonitor) to effectively guide NOC event management.

  
  

Certifications

  
  

Required: ITIL v4 Foundation Certification.

  
  

Preferred: ITIL v4 Managing Professional (MP) or ITIL v4 Create, Deliver and Support.

  
  

Bonus: Basic networking or cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Cloud Practitioner, CompTIA Network+) to aid in NOC technical communication.

  
  

Core Competencies

  
  

Strategic & Process-Oriented: Exceptional ability to design theoretical frameworks and translate them into practical, daily habits for technical teams.

  
  

Crisis Management: Highly structured, calm, and authoritative when leading major incident war rooms.

  
  

Bridge-Builder: Skilled at bridging the gap between high-level business requirements (ITSM) and deeply technical, rapid-response execution (NOC).

  
  

Analytical Decision Making: Highly proficient in interpreting ITSM and monitoring data to justify process changes or infrastructure investments.

**Job Description:**

**What’s the role**

As an Environmental Reporting Engineer, you will support environmental performance management by ensuring the accurate, complete, and timely collection, analysis, and reporting of environmental data. The role is responsible for regulatory reporting, environmental performance monitoring, compliance tracking, and driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance reporting processes and data quality.

  

**What you’ll be doing**

* **Environmental & Regulatory Reporting:** Coordinate periodic environmental reporting and regulatory submissions covering areas such as atmospheric emissions, waste, chemicals, water discharges, pollutant releases and other environmental performance requirements.
* **Environmental Data Management:** Manage environmental data collection, validation, quality assurance and reporting across relevant systems and dashboards, including emissions data, environmental KPIs, exposure hours and environmental events.
* **Performance Monitoring & Assurance:** Conduct periodic environmental performance reviews, identify data-quality or performance gaps, and support timely submission of environmental performance information to internal and external stakeholders.
* **GHG & Methane Reporting:** Support annual greenhouse gas reporting, reconciliation and assurance activities, including methane/OGMP reconciliation, GHG movements, self-assessments and related environmental disclosures.
* **Environmental Compliance Support:** Support environmental permit and compliance reporting activities, including periodic returns, forecasting, limit variations and environmental site assessment information relating to areas such as soil, groundwater and noise.
* **Environmental Systems & Reporting Tools:** Maintain environmental reporting systems, dashboards and SharePoint-based reports, ensuring data is current, traceable and fit for reporting purposes.
* **Safety & Environmental KPI Reporting:** Compile and communicate relevant environmental, personal safety and process safety KPIs to appropriate stakeholders to support ongoing performance monitoring.
* **Reporting Transformation:** Support transition and improvement of environmental reporting processes and systems, including migration to new environmental data and insights platforms.
* **Continuous Improvement & Digitalization:** Identify opportunities to simplify, automate and standardize environmental reporting through digital solutions, dashboards and process improvements.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work with environmental, safety, operations and reporting stakeholders to resolve data gaps, improve reporting quality and ensure reporting requirements are delivered on time.

**What you bring**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Carbon Management, or a related discipline.
* At least 4 years of experience in environmental engineering, including GHG emissions calculations, emissions monitoring, and process performance management within the oil and gas industry.
* Strong expertise in environmental data management, reporting, data validation, quality assurance, and environmental performance analysis.
* Advanced knowledge of GHG accounting methodologies, emissions reporting, and environmental regulatory compliance requirements, including existing and emerging global air and water reporting regulations.
* In-depth understanding of equipment, processes, and emission sources across oil and gas facilities, with the ability to interpret operational data and environmental impacts.
* Proficiency in digital reporting and process optimization tools, including Power Apps, PI System, PI ProcessBook, PI Vision, SEEQ, SAP EC, Aspen HYSYS, and UniSim, with a proven track record of driving process simplification and digitalization initiatives.
* Experience monitoring and interpreting GHG accounting protocols, standards updates, and reporting requirements, serving as a subject matter resource for environmental and carbon reporting activities.
* Proven ability to develop, optimize, and maintain internal processes that align with external environmental standards, guidelines, and regulatory obligations.
* Strong stakeholder management, analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with a continuous improvement mindset.
Demonstrated commitment to professional development, including maintaining relevant sustainability and environmental reporting credentials to support evolving business and regulatory requirements.  

**What we offer**

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.



**An Inclusive & Progressive Place to Work**

* To power progress together, we need to attract and develop the brightest minds and make sure every voice is heard. Here are just some of the ways we’re nurturing an inclusive environment – one where you can express your ideas, extend your skills, and reach your potential.
* We’re creating a space where people with disabilities can excel through transparent recruitment process, workplace adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Feel free to let us know about your circumstances when you apply, and we’ll take it from there.
* We’re closing the gender gap – whether that’s through action on equal pay or by enabling more women to reach senior roles in engineering and technology.
We’re striving to be a pioneer of an inclusive and diverse workplace, promoting equality for employees regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity.  

**Shell in India**

Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R&D, digitalisation, and business operations.

Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050. As India moves towards its target of net-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.

Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end-to-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.

Shell owns and operates a LNG re-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and a LNG truck-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Sprng Energy in a $1.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Sprng is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.

Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.

We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programmes on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.

Please note: We occasionally amend or withdraw Shell jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Before applying, you are advised to read our data protection policy. This policy describes the processing that may be associated with your personal data and informs you that your personal data may be transferred to Shell/Shell Group companies around the world. The Shell Group and its approved recruitment consultants will never ask you for a fee to process or consider your application for a career with Shell. Anyone who demands such a fee is not an authorised Shell representative and you are strongly advised to refuse any such demand. Shell is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

description:
**Principal Software Engineer – System Test & Validation (SONiC AI & Enterprise Networking)**

**Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

**Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.**

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.

We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Principal Software Engineer on our System Test Engineering Team in Chennai, India.

**What you’ll achieve**

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will be responsible for system and solution-level validation of SONiC-based AI and enterprise networking platforms, from test strategy and automation through root-cause analysis. As a successful candidate, you will be a technically savvy, passionate, and strongly self-driven engineer who drives the deliverables and objectives entrusted to you, your team, and scrums, working with engineering and architecture teams on customer use-case and solution-centric validation at multidimensional scale across complex rack-scale networking and compute deployments. Hiring at the Principal Software Engineer level or below, based on technical expertise, experience, and demonstrated impact.

**You will:**

* Design and execute system and solution-level validation, translating product requirements, architecture documents, and specifications into comprehensive test plans and cases aligned with spec-driven and test-driven development (SDD/TDD).
* Validate use-case and solution-centric functional, performance, resiliency, interoperability, and end-to-end scenarios at multidimensional scale, including RoCE and lossless-fabric behavior under congestion (PFC, ECN, link-level retransmission, and retransmits).
* Track link-level health across test runs and releases, including error counters, link flaps, and FEC and CRC trends.
* Build and improve Python and SpyTest automation and AI agents that improve execution efficiency, impact, and value, accelerating CI/CD pipelines and test coverage.
* Analyze logs, telemetry, packet captures, and system behavior to identify root causes, close field escapes, and resolve complex issues through triage and closure.

**Take the first step towards your dream career**

Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:

**Essential Requirements**

* System and solution validation: system testing and end-to-end validation of AI, data center, and enterprise networking solutions at multidimensional scale, including troubleshooting complex scale-up, scale-across, scale-out, and rack-scale networking and compute deployments.
* Networking technologies: VXLAN-EVPN, MLAG, EVPN-MH, ECMP, VRF, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, SRv6, BFD, VLAN, LACP, LLDP, STP, multicast, and network services (DHCP, DNS, NTP, LDAP, RADIUS, TACACS+, 802.1X).
* AI fabric performance: RoCE, QoS, DCB (PFC/ECN), lossless Ethernet, link-level retransmission, latency, performance, and resiliency, including collective-communication traffic on GPU clusters.
* Automation and telemetry: strong Python and test automation skills, with automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, validation at scale, telemetry and northbound interfaces (CLI, REST, gNMI, NETCONF/YANG), packet analysis, and traffic generator testing (for example IXIA).
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering in CSE, ECE, EEE, IT, Computer Networks, Cloud Computing, or equivalent.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Hands-on SpyTest and network test automation, spec-driven or test-driven development (SDD/TDD), familiarity with server and storage environments, and data analysis for trend and escape analysis (SQL, pandas).
* Experience building or using AI agents and AI-assisted workflows (AI models and tools, for example Claude, Devin, GitHub Copilot) for test development, automation, analysis, and troubleshooting, and exposure to emerging scale-up fabric standards (for example UALink and Ultra Ethernet).  
    
  **Application closing date: 16/11/2026.**

**Who We Are**

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.

Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us.

* Bachelor's degree in relevant engineering discipline

* Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills.

* Minimum 10 years of experience in sales and tendering of power systems, with a focus on substations.

* Willingness to travel for site assessments and project meetings.

* Opportunities for continuous professional growth and development
* A strong, collaborative, and supportive team culture
* Long-term career prospects within a growing and forward-thinking organization

COWRKS Rmz Millenia Business Park, 600096 Chennai Tamil Nadu, India

Can you picture yourself diagnosing critical issues in minutes, enabling faster incident response, seamless change, and stronger risk decisions for thousands of colleagues worldwide?

**Accountabilities:**
---------------------

* Act as the technical authority for CI classes, attributes, and relationships. Optimize IRE rules and reconciliation precedence. Maintain a single, reconciled source of truth. Use CMDB Health, the 360-degree CMDB view, and the Data Manager tool to improve data quality continuously.
* Discovery and Service Mapping Skills: Build, provide, and resolve issues in asset identification and the visualization of services for both on-premises and cloud environments, adjusting schedules, MID Servers, credentials, ranges, and patterns to improve coverage, precision, and dependability of application-to-infrastructure connections.
* CSDM Modelling and Implementation: Define and socialize modeling patterns across Business Applications, Application and Business Services, Technical Services and Service Offerings; remediate legacy models and embed consistent, standards-based onboarding.
* CMDB Integrations and Data Controls: Engineer robust Service Graph and IntegrationHub ETL integrations for cloud, endpoint, security and network sources; normalize and reconcile data across APIs, transforms and IRE with clear monitoring, exception handling and data-quality controls.
* Standards, Reviews and Guidance: Set technical standards, challenge unnecessary customization, review solution designs and provide hands-on guidance to implementation teams to ensure scalable, maintainable outcomes.
* Influence Across Multiple Functions: Partner with platform, cyber, cloud, infrastructure, network, architecture and application collaborators to align builds, resolve issues at speed and increase business value from configuration data.
* Continuous Improvement and Automation: Use scripting, Flow Designer and ATF to automate quality checks, lifecycle controls and regression testing; drive an experimentation approach to simplify, standardize and scale.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or equivalent experience.
* 8–12+ years of technology experience, including 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow CMDB / ITOM delivery and 2+ years in a technical lead capacity.
* Experience delivering at least two major enterprise CMDB implementations or transformations, with strong hands-on experience in automated resource identification and service topology documentation.
* Practical enterprise CSDM implementation experience, with expertise in CI class models, IRE, identification and reconciliation, and ITIL 4 configuration management practices.
* Significant hands-on experience configuring and administering CMDB, Discovery, MID Servers, patterns, Service Graph Connectors and CMDB Health, with working-to-advanced knowledge of CMDB 360 and Data Manager.
* Demonstrated ability to integrate multiple authoritative data sources through IntegrationHub ETL, REST/SOAP APIs and transform maps, including AWS and/or Azure environments.
* Proficiency in ServiceNow scripting and automation, encompassing JavaScript, developing with Flow Designer features and Business Rules, plus platform governance with update sets, Automated Test Framework (ATF) and release management.
* Experience leading technical delivery, mentoring engineers and handling third-party or outsourced service provider resources.
* Strong analytical and root-cause skills in fixing issues within large enterprise environments, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to technical and non-technical collaborators.

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* Relevant ServiceNow certifications in system administration, CMDB, Discovery or Service Mapping; ITIL 4 Foundation or above.
* Experience in the biopharmaceutical or life sciences industry, or another regulated environment, including GxP.
* Experience with ServiceNow Predictive Intelligence.
* Experience with security exposure and vulnerability management tooling.
* Experience working across cultures and time zones, including a Global Technology Centre operating model.
* Experience with software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile and Scrum methodologies.

description:
Adtech Systems Limited is a BSE-listed company with its Registered Office in Chennai and Corporate Office in Trivandrum, Kerala. The company has an established presence across major Indian cities through its branch network, supported by service engineers stationed at various locations to provide timely customer support and service delivery.

Role Summary

The Branch Operations Manager will be responsible for ensuring the effective management and smooth functioning of all operational and administrative activities of the assigned branch.

The role involves overseeing branch administration, inventory and asset management, service coordination, financial and commercial processes, compliance, and operational reporting. The incumbent will work closely with the Branch Manager, Corporate Office, and various functional teams to ensure adherence to company policies, efficient utilization of resources, and achievement of operational objectives.

The position requires a proactive, result-oriented professional capable of maintaining strong operational controls, improving processes, and ensuring seamless coordination across branch functions and geographically dispersed service teams.

Key Responsibilities1. Branch Operations & Administration

· Manage and monitor the day-to-day operational and administrative activities of the branch.

· Ensure effective coordination among sales, service, stores, finance, and administration teams.

· Implement and monitor compliance with company policies, procedures, and standard operating practices.

· Monitor branch expenditure, resource utilization, and administrative efficiency.

· Ensure proper upkeep and maintenance of branch premises, infrastructure, facilities, and equipment.

2. Inventory & Asset Management

· Oversee inventory management, including material receipts, issues, transfers, and stock movement documentation.

· Ensure accuracy of inventory records through periodic physical verification and reconciliation.

· Coordinate with the Corporate Office and relevant departments for material planning and replenishment.

· Maintain effective control over inventory to minimize discrepancies, wastage, and excess stock.

· Ensure proper tracking, safeguarding, and utilization of company-owned assets and equipment.

3. Service Operations & Coordination

· Coordinate and monitor the activities of service engineers operating within the branch's assigned territory, including engineers stationed at remote locations.

· Track service requests, installations, preventive maintenance schedules, and customer complaints.

· Ensure timely allocation of service resources and availability of required materials and spares.

· Monitor service response times, turnaround times, pending complaints, and service delivery performance.

· Liaise with the central service team and Corporate Office to resolve operational and technical coordination issues.

4. Financial & Commercial Operations

· Monitor branch operating expenses and ensure compliance with approved budgets and financial controls.

· Coordinate with the Finance Department on billing, collections, employee expense claims, vendor payments, and related documentation.

· Ensure timely submission and accuracy of invoices, vouchers, expense statements, and supporting records.

· Monitor cash transactions, wherever applicable, in accordance with company procedures.

· Maintain proper financial and commercial records and provide necessary support during internal and statutory audits.

5. People Management & Coordination

· Supervise and monitor the performance of branch operations and administrative personnel.

· Allocate responsibilities, monitor task completion, and ensure accountability among team members.

· Identify training and development requirements to improve employee productivity and operational effectiveness.

· Promote discipline, teamwork, professional conduct, and adherence to company policies.

· Coordinate with the HR Department on attendance, leave administration, manpower requirements, and employee-related matters.

6. Compliance, Documentation & Audit

· Ensure adherence to company policies, applicable statutory requirements, safety standards, and regulatory guidelines.

· Maintain accurate and updated records relating to inventory, assets, employees, vendors, expenses, and branch operations.

· Coordinate internal audits, address audit observations, and ensure timely implementation of corrective actions.

· Ensure proper documentation, record maintenance, and compliance with prescribed reporting procedures.

7. Customer Service & Operational Issue Resolution

· Ensure prompt attention and resolution of customer-related operational issues and service escalations.

· Monitor customer feedback and identify opportunities for improving service quality.

· Escalate critical operational issues to the Branch Manager and Corporate Office with appropriate recommendations.

· Prepare and submit periodic operational reports to the Branch Manager and Corporate Office.

title: Sr Engineer I - Process Development
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**

**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.**

As a member of a cross functional team, you lead RDQ activities required to complete process design and process deployment for innovation, growth and cost optimization projects across multiple geographies with an emphasis on delivering the desired consumer experience.

**How you will contribute**

Working independently, you will lead technical work across multiple projects aligned with RDQ, marketing and manufacturing requirements, effectively communicating status and risks. You will also lead activities designed to generate appropriate process information using modelling and simulation, and pilot plant scale up and factory trials in accordance with good manufacturing practice and HACCP requirements. You will be involved with/lead process design and specifications, process scale-up and commissioning and will ensure the effective use of resources, including the use of external agencies. This position requires you to manage stakeholders and to influence decisions based on data analysis and interpretation of results; create and maintain accurate consumer centric process specifications; leverage connections to internal and external technical communities, and; create intellectual property that gives Mondelēz International a competitive advantage.

**What you will bring**

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

* Process development and/or process deployment ideally in a fast-moving consumer goods environment
* Leading project teams and influencing cross-functional teams
* Planning and delivering on multiple priorities
* Identifying complex technical or business problems and creating and implementing solutions
* Understanding equipment design and manufacturing processes to support process specifications
* Using technical data to influence stakeholders
* Coaching and mentoring others in a process community
* Being a constant champion for the consumer

**More about this role**

You work as part of a cross-functional team to lead and deliver the activities required to complete Process Design and Process Deployment for Innovation, Growth and Productivity projects across multiple geographies with an emphasis on delivering the desired consumer experience

**What you need to know about this position:**

**What extra ingredients you will bring:**

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

* Relevant engineering experience, ideally within a fast-moving consumer goods environment
* Working in teams and independently with appropriate guidance
* Prioritizing and managing activities
* Identifying problems proactively and creating and implementing solutions
* Applying fundamental technical understanding to interpret and analyze data and to reach clear conclusions
* Communicating technical information effectively verbally and in writing
* Constantly championing for the consumer
* Technical curiosity, continuous learner and a drive to ensure technical rigor

**Job specific requirements:**

With the support of a manager and technical coaches, you will design and implement projects in line with RDQ, marketing and manufacturing requirements and effectively communicate project statuses and risks. As part of that planning process, you will conduct activities to generate the appropriate process information, using modelling, simulations, and pilot plant and plant trials in accordance with good manufacturing practices and HACCP requirements. In this role, you will assist in planning the effective use of resources, including the use of external agencies, and manage stakeholders, making recommendations and influencing decisions based on analysis and interpretation of data. title: Maintenance & Test System Engineer
description:
**The Impact You'll Make**
--------------------------

At Danfoss, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of the variable frequency drives that power critical industrial applications worldwide. By maintaining and optimizing automated production test systems, you will help deliver products that meet the highest standards before they reach our customers.

Based at our Oragadam, Chennai manufacturing site, this is a hands-on opportunity to work at the intersection of electrical engineering, automation, and production excellence. You will collaborate with manufacturing, quality, and engineering teams to improve testing processes, support new product introductions, and drive continuous improvement.

Your work will directly contribute to product quality, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction while supporting Danfoss' commitment to sustainable and innovative technologies.

**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Maintain and optimize automated production test equipment to ensure reliable product testing and uninterrupted manufacturing operations.
* Calibrate, troubleshoot, and improve test systems and measuring instruments to maintain accuracy, compliance, and product quality.
* Support new product introductions by collaborating with cross-functional teams to enable smooth and efficient production launches.
* Update and enhance test software, hardware, and network configurations to improve system performance and testing effectiveness.
* Analyze test data and lead continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen quality, reduce waste, and improve manufacturing outcomes.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Experience maintaining or supporting electrical, electronic, or automated test systems in a manufacturing environment.
* Working knowledge of test automation platforms such as LabVIEW, TestStand, PLC-based systems, or similar industrial testing tools.
* Understanding of electrical systems, power electronics, variable frequency drives, motors, or industrial control equipment.
* Experience with calibration practices, measurement systems, and quality methodologies used in manufacturing environments.
* Ability to solve technical problems, collaborate with diverse stakeholders, and support an on-site manufacturing operation, including shift-based work when required.

**What You'll Get from Us**
---------------------------

At Danfoss, you'll join a purpose-driven company committed to engineering solutions that enable a more sustainable future.

You can expect:

* Opportunities to work with advanced manufacturing and test technologies in a global organization.
* Exposure to cross-functional and international collaboration across engineering, quality, and operations teams.
* A culture that values continuous learning, innovation, and employee development.
* The opportunity to contribute to new product introductions and meaningful improvement projects with visible business impact.
* An inclusive workplace where different perspectives are valued and individuals are empowered to grow and succeed.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**
-------------------------------

If you're excited about improving manufacturing quality, solving technical challenges, and contributing to products used around the world, we'd love to hear from you.

**Description**

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd

**ITS Vice Presidency Context:**

The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150+ locations. For more information on ITS, see this video:https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload=9&v=VTFGffa1Y7w

**Department Context**

The World Bank Group Technology Office (ITSTO) defines and executes the technology strategy for the World Bank Group, ensuring that technological investments and standards deliver secure, resilient, and efficient platforms to support global operations. Through strategic planning, enterprise architecture, platform engineering, and core infrastructure management, ITSTO aligns technology initiatives with the Bank Group’s mission and business objectives.

ITSTO drives technology-enabled innovation, modernizes infrastructure, and enhances organizational agility. By fostering collaboration across all World Bank Group entities—including IBRD, IDA, IFC, MIGA, and ICSID—ITSTO leverages technology as a catalyst for accelerating development impact and advancing digital transformation. Its leadership ensures that technology serves as a strategic enabler for achieving the Bank Group’s development goals, empowering the institution to address emerging challenges and opportunities with greater efficiency and effectiveness.

**Unit Context**

The Infrastructure Engineering team is instrumental in advancing the World Bank Group’s mission by designing, building, and maintaining the foundational IT infrastructure that supports global operations. The team manages critical infrastructure components end-to-end, including data centers, infrastructure as code, enterprise networks, storage systems, compute resources, virtualization platforms, and disaster recovery solutions. Their efforts ensure that infrastructure services are robust, secure, scalable, and cost-effective, forming the backbone for reliable digital services across all business units.

Committed to operational excellence and continuous improvement, Infrastructure Engineering proactively monitors and optimizes infrastructure performance to meet evolving business needs. The team leads modernization initiatives, adopts emerging technologies, and implements best practices in infrastructure management. Collaboration with other technology teams—including cloud engineering, cybersecurity, application development, and IT service management—ensures seamless integration of cloud, automation, and security strategies.

Supporting the World Bank Group’s digital transformation agenda, Infrastructure Engineering champions innovative solutions and automation to enhance the productivity and efficiency of IT operations. The team also plays a vital role in ensuring business continuity and resilience through comprehensive disaster recovery planning and execution. By fostering a culture of collaboration, agility, and technical excellence, Infrastructure Engineering empowers the organization to deliver reliable, high-performing digital services that enable global development operations and advance the Bank’s strategic objectives.

**Duties and accountabilities:**

The DevOps/DDI Engineer is responsible for maintaining the enterprise DDI (DNS, DHCP and IPAM) infrastructure and developing automation scripts and tools to improve the network reliability and visibility.

For this role, the ideal candidate is a technology leader with strong interpersonal skills, capable of energizing and influencing others, fostering collaboration, building consensus, and proactively addressing challenges to achieve key deliverables.

The role requires a hands-on approach in a multicultural environment which supports diversity, continuous learning, enhancing skillsets and collaboration. The ideal candidate must demonstrate excellent communication skills as the position requires frequent interaction with multiple cross-functional teams. The candidate must possess a strong sense of curiosity, adaptability, and the drive to learn and innovate.

We provide a meaningful, open, and collaborative environment. We have many interesting problems to solve, providing you an opportunity to develop your skills while contributing to the mission of the bank. We value teamwork, openness, curiosity, and persistence.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Primary responsibility of this position is listed below:**

* Manage the product lifecycle of operational system infrastructure (DDI and automation tools) to ensure operational availability; design and specify changes for implementation.
* Receive performance data and analyze the performance of installed technologies. Propose and implement any required changes, including identifying and planning for any resulting impacts on other technologies.
* Continue to develop expertise in their domain and seek to expand their knowledge into other areas of the network infrastructure.
* Resolve recurring problems and document appropriate procedures.
* Prepare reports on a monthly/quarterly basis for project metrics, SLAs, and achievements.
* Document new procedures in a clear and concise manner. May participate in the development of new or modified procedures.
* Provide direction, technical guidance, and mentorship to team members, as appropriate.
* May lead moderate to large sized projects.
* Oversee implementation efforts related to their area of responsibility.
* Possess experience in implementing procedural solutions to support and monitor the effective operations of an element(s) of the network infrastructure.
* Understand the business impact of different solutions, and assess the tradeoffs between business needs, technology requirements, and costs.
* Conduct complete diagnostics of most business problems, factoring in a strong understanding of the technical architecture.
* Find solutions to and develop documentation for advanced operations problems.
* Follow and execute standardized procedures, under guidance. Supervisor is readily available to address non-standard situations.

**Specific Activities Include:**

* Maintain the World Bank Group’s DDI infrastructure based on Infoblox.
* Manage cloud-based DNS components in AWS and Azure clouds.
* Automate the environment using various scripts and tools like Python, Perl, Ansible and Terraform.
* Enhance the team’s proactive monitoring capability by creating automated reports/alerts for network events.
* Ensure compliance with various security standards for the environment.
* Handle escalation calls from the NOC, perform triage, and resolve problems.
* Provide continuous monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintenance of the various network equipment and associated peripherals, including adequate follow up on Problem Resolution tracking using the ServiceNow tool.
* Monitor and review use of systems for World Bank access control policy violations in line with World Bank’s guidelines.
* Ensure that the defined decommissioning and disposal procedures are followed for all hardware systems and media.
* Report and respond to critical security events and take corrective measures per defined security incident management processes.
* Follow and comply with the World Bank Group policies, processes, and procedures.
* Participate in audits, as needed, producing necessary documentation, reports, and explanations, and implement corrective and preventive action plans approved by unit managers.
* Take personal responsibility and accountability for timely response to client queries, requests or needs, while working to remove obstacles that may impede execution or overall success.
* Able to present and explain technical information to diverse types of audience (management, users, vendor, and technical staff)

**Selection Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree with 7 years of experience or master’s degree with 5 years relevant experience OR equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Hands-on experience with Infoblox DDI in a large enterprise network.
* Excellent understanding of the DNS and DHCP protocols.
* Extensive experience using APIs with Infoblox, Cloud providers, ServiceNow and Splunk.
* Good understanding of networking protocols and services, including TCP/IP, IPSEC, GRE, VLSM, VLANs, OSPF, BGP, and IP Anycast.
* Proficiency with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure)
* Experience in automating tasks using scripting languages and tools like Python, Perl, Ansible and Terraform.
* Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps.
* Ability to analyze large data sets using scripts to generate insightful reports and actionable alerts.
* Ability to collaborate within the team and across boundaries.
* Ability to contribute to and readily apply WBG’s body of knowledge for internal and/or external client solutions.
* Ability and willingness to work, learn and contribute to an internationally diverse team environment.
* Fluency in English.

**Certifications**

* SAFe Agilist (SA) or SAFe Practitioner (SP), preferred

**WBG Culture Attributes:**

1. Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.  
2. Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
  
3. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.
