title: Senior Manager- Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
ENGINEER

**Location: Chennai (on site) | Type: Fulltime**

**About Newpage Solutions**
===========================

Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organisations which include, pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges.

From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices.

We are proud to be a ‘**Great Place to Work®’ certified** company for the last three consecutive years. We also hold a top **Glassdoor rating** and are named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. As an organisation, we foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people’s lives.

**Your Mission**
================

We are hiring a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to take the hardest AI problems in Finance and Global Business Services from whiteboard to production for a global pharmaceutical company, and to set the patterns the rest of the team builds on. You will join a function team, define the problem, and lead the build from first prototype through production handoff and support, taking the engagements that span multiple systems or teams in areas such as financial close, forecasting, accounts receivable, procure-to-pay, tax, treasury and shared services operations.

This is a senior hands-on individual contributor and technical lead role in the company's Finance and Global Business Services technology and AI capability center in Chennai. You will set the engineering patterns other Forward Deployed Engineers follow, review their designs and code, and still write code every week, alongside Product Owners, process owners, and digital platform and architecture teams. You will work directly with Finance and Global Business Services leaders worldwide, so you find out fast whether what you build works. You can grow your career through technical leadership without moving into people management. Success is measured by adoption, demonstrable business outcomes (time saved, quality, risk, controls, cycle time, better decisions, financial impact) and how much of your work others reuse.

The role needs regular overlap with US and European time zones, including some early-evening IST calls, and can be demanding at times, including period-end close support and leading the response to production incidents. You don't need every bonus skill listed. If you have led AI into production that people use and want to work close to the business, we want to hear from you.

**What You’ll Do**
==================

**Problem Discovery and Business Partnership**
----------------------------------------------

* Work in person in Chennai while embedding virtually with assigned Finance and Global Business Services teams.
* Lead discovery for complex, cross-functional use cases through regular calls, screen-share walkthroughs and process reviews with senior stakeholders and process owners across regions, including the US and Europe, and shape them into roadmaps with measurable outcomes.
* Work with Product Owners to turn priorities and specifications into solution designs and delivery plans, and to rank use cases by value, feasibility and risk.
* Say no, or not yet, when a use case lacks data, sponsorship or a clear value case, and push back when a specification doesn't match the underlying problem or runs into technical issues and limitations.

**Technical Leadership and Build**
----------------------------------

* Serve as technical lead on complex engagements: own solution design, stay hands-on in the code, and lead the design of agentic AI built with frontier models on the company's enterprise AI platforms.
* Design multi-agent and multi-step workflows on Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI and other market-leading runtimes, using frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph and Lang Chain, with MCP, A2A and APIs connecting enterprise systems, deterministic business rules and human approval steps.
* Set coding standards, evaluation practice and quality bars for the engagements you lead, including review standards for AI-generated code.
* Use AI coding agents in your daily workflow to speed delivery, show other engineers how to use them well, and make build-versus-buy and platform choices with digital platform and architecture teams.

**Data and Enterprise Integration**
-----------------------------------

* Lead integration across Finance and Global Business Services data and systems through governed MCP tools or APIs and certified data products, such as SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, SAP Ariba and Business Network, Oracle EPM, Microsoft 365, other enterprise platforms and custom solutions.
* Help shape a shared Finance and Global Business Services data and AI foundation (ontology, rules engine, MCP tool library and decision ledger), and decide which patterns become shared building blocks.
* Define data contracts, semantic models and access patterns, and extend the shared ontology and business rules, such as Delegation of Authority, Segregation of Duties and materiality, that other engineers and agents reuse.
* Set data access, entitlement and classification practice for financial and personal data on the engagements you lead.

**Controls, Compliance and Responsible AI**
-------------------------------------------

* Own control design for your solutions. Engage SOX, Internal Audit, Privacy, Legal, Security and AI governance early, including data privacy (GDPR, India DPDP Act) and EU AI Act review, and pass required gates before release.
* Define evaluation and monitoring for accuracy, drift and failure modes on financial outputs, and make sure agent evidence, approvals and actions are recorded in the decision ledger.
* Enforce responsible AI safeguards: data access controls, prompt injection defenses, human review and output monitoring.

**Production, Reliability and Reuse**
-------------------------------------

* Own production readiness and ongoing support for the solutions you lead: LLMOps practice, deployment pipelines, monitoring, incident response and run costs.
* Establish support ownership, runbooks, service expectations, escalation paths, knowledge transfer and root cause analysis for production solutions.
* Set the standard for logging, tracing, monitoring and alerting with Azure Monitor, Application Insights and Foundry Observability.
* Convert proven solutions into reusable components, templates and accelerators across Finance and Global Business Services, and identify and pay down technical debt before it blocks scale.

**Mentoring, Value and Adoption**
---------------------------------

* Mentor Manager-level Forward Deployed Engineers, and engineers in Finance and Global Business Services function teams, through design reviews, pairing and code review.
* Contribute to Forward Deployed Engineering playbooks, interview loops and team upskilling.
* Build business cases and track realized value: hours saved, cycle time, cost avoidance and risk reduction.
* Present results and tradeoffs to senior Finance and Global Business Services stakeholders and Forward Deployed Engineering leadership, and build champions in the business so adoption sticks.

**What You Bring**
==================

**Engineering and AI Delivery**
-------------------------------

* 7+ years of software or data engineering experience, including at least three years building and shipping LLM-based applications to production, with at least one multi-step agentic system with tool use, evaluation and monitoring.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field.
* Technical lead experience on complex, multi-system builds.
* Expert-level Python, with strong TypeScript/JavaScript and SQL.
* Hands-on experience with cloud architecture, ideally Azure; AWS is also considered. Includes API-first design, CI/CD and observability.
* Hands-on LLMOps practice: evaluation, tracing, and prompt, model and agent versioning.
* Daily use of AI coding agents in your own engineering work, with the judgement to review AI-generated code.

**Business Partnership and Leadership**
---------------------------------------

* Able to partner with the business, turn messy problems into working solutions, and show the impact in numbers.
* Proven ability to influence senior business stakeholders without formal authority.
* Experience mentoring engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* A Master's degree in a technical field, or a finance or accounting background combined with engineering experience.
* Deep knowledge of finance processes such as record-to-report, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, FP&A or treasury, or prior work in finance technology.
* Experience integrating with SAP (S/4HANA, GTS, Ariba), Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, the Azure AI stack (AI Foundry, AI Search, Document Intelligence, Azure ML), Vertex AI or Oracle EPM; comparable enterprise platforms are also considered.
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, Lang Graph or Lang Chain, MCP server development and A2A; other orchestration frameworks are also considered.
* Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs or rules engines.
* Experience with SOX and IT general controls in a regulated industry.
* Experience turning bespoke solutions into reusable platforms or products.
* AWS or Azure Solutions Architect or Developer certification, or the equivalent on other market-leading platforms.

**What We Offer**
=================

At Newpage, we’re building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer:

* A people-first culture - Supportive peers, open communication and a strong sense of belonging
* Smart, purposeful collaboration - Work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges
* Balance that lasts - We respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life
* Room to grow - Opportunities for learning, leadership and career development, shaped around you
* Meaningful rewards - Competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential

**Ready to Apply?**
===================

Let’s build the future of health together. Apply below or reach out to:

*Ramadevi.bhumireddy@newpage.io*

#### **More about Newpage**

Newpage is a digital health solutions company. We devote ourselves to advancing the quality of life by enhancing health and optimizing the longevity of people. We do this by, passionately building futuristic technologies for global organizations across the healthcare ecosystem. We partake at every stage from problem definition, strategy & service design, user research, UX design, and agile software development – utilizing lean practices to deliver and validate highly innovative digital health solutions that drive user value and business transformation.

Newpage is recognized by ‘CIO’s Review’ as “Top 50 Promising Healthcare Solution Providers” and Great Place to Work Certified (GPTW) 2023 & 2024.

Job Description:  
Key Responsibilities  
Job Description: Azure Data Cloud Architect  
Position Overview  
We are seeking an experienced and visionary Azure Data Cloud Architect to lead the strategy, design, and modernization of cutting-edge, enterprise-scale data solutions on Microsoft Azure. In this role, you will serve as a strategic technical leader bridging business strategy and technology execution. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders—including the Data Hub, Digital & AI teams, and DevOps—to translate complex business requirements into high-performing, resilient, secure, and cost-effective cloud data architectures.  
Your deep expertise in Azure cloud data services, advanced data modeling, modern ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud governance, and enterprise digital transformation will drive continuous innovation, scalability, and efficiency across our global data ecosystem.  
  
Key Strategic Focus Areas  

* Solution Architecting: Designing robust, multi-region end-to-end architectures that leverage the full power of Azure native data and analytics services.
* Modernization & Cloud Migration: Leading the evolution from legacy data warehouses, databases, and on-premises infrastructure to cloud-native Azure data solutions.
* Digital & AI Transformation: Enabling advanced analytics, machine learning, and business intelligence capabilities that empower data-driven decision-making across the enterprise.

  
Detailed Roles, Responsibilities & Key Activities  
1. Strategic Solution Architecting  

* End-to-End Architectural Leadership: Design, architect, and deliver scalable, resilient, and secure data platform architectures utilizing the complete Azure data ecosystem (e.g., Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure SQL Database, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and Azure Data Lake Storage).
* Business & Technical Alignment: Partner closely with business stakeholders, product managers, and leadership in Digital & AI to evaluate business needs and translate them into high-level architectures (HLD) and technical architecture documents (TAD).
* Target State Architecture: Define future-state data architecture roadmaps, network flow matrices, environment topologies, secret inventories, and enterprise data models (star/snowflake schemas, Data Vault, or relational models).

2. Modernization & Enterprise Data Transformation  

* Legacy System Cloud Migration: Architect and execute cloud migration strategies to transition legacy on-premises databases, data warehouses, and ETL jobs into modernized Azure cloud-native equivalents with minimal operational disruption.
* Modern Data Integration (ETL/ELT): Oversee and optimize real-time, micro-batch, and batch data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and Event Driven architectures to accelerate time-to-insight.
* Innovation & Emerging Technologies: Continuously evaluate emerging cloud, AI/ML, and IoT technology capabilities (e.g., Azure ML, Logic Apps, Service Bus) to solve complex data challenges and expand automated operational workflows.

3. Implementation, Governance, Security & Operations  

* Data Security & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure full compliance with global and enterprise data privacy and security standards (including GDPR, HIPAA, UK data residency regulations, and client-specific security standards such as Sodexo policies).
* Automated Governance & Lineage: Establish comprehensive data governance frameworks encompassing metadata management, enterprise data cataloging, lineage tracking, data quality monitoring, and role-based access control (RBAC).
* DevOps, IaC & Automation: Work with DevOps teams to drive automated infrastructure provisioning and continuous delivery using Infrastructure as Code (IaC with Azure Bicep/ARM templates/Terraform) and Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.
* Security & Vulnerability Remediation: Regularly review security compliance reports (e.g., Sodexo's CACTUS tool, Azure Security Center) and leverage Azure Key Vault, Private Endpoints, and Managed Identities to remediate security risks.
* Performance Tuning & Cost Optimization: Monitor, audit, and tune data pipelines, query performance, and storage tiers for maximum speed, enterprise resilience, and cloud cost efficiency (FinOps).

4. Technical Leadership, Mentorship & Stakeholder Collaboration  

* Team Mentorship & Guidance: Act as a hands-on technical mentor to data engineers, data analysts, and data scientists, instilling cloud design patterns and architecture best practices.
* Cross-Functional Synergy: Foster seamless collaboration between data engineering, infrastructure, security, DevOps, and business analytics teams.
* Operational Guidelines & Standards: Author standard operating procedures, architectural guidelines, reference architectures, and deployment documentation.

  
Required Qualifications & Experience  
Education  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field (Master’s Degree preferred).

description:

As a key member of the IMG MP&L team, the MFPE (Material Flow & Packaging Engineering) Engineer will be responsible for leading packaging validation, logistics parameter verification, and comprehensive cost impact assessments during the sourcing process for New Programs. Working closely with Purchasing, PD, and Plant Packaging teams, you will evaluate supplier proposals to secure optimal packaging designs and the best Total Enterprise Landed Cost for Ford. Your expertise will be vital in reviewing supplier logistics terms, validating dunnage fleet calculations, and driving on-time packaging approvals through Sourcing Evaluation Teams (SET) and GPDS gateways. You will champion Design for Logistics (DFL) and TVM initiatives to deliver sustainable, cost-effective packaging and freight solutions across the program lifecycle.

* Strategic Sourcing Support : Actively participate in Sourcing TO4 meetings alongside Purchasing and PD, providing data-driven packaging and logistics insights to influence supplier selection and secure optimal program costs.
* Total Landed Cost Impact Assessment: Collaborate with Purchasing, Finance, and MP&L teams to assess and optimize the Total Enterprise Landed Cost—evaluating the cost impact of freight, duty, packaging, and handling across competing sourcing scenarios.
* Logistics Terms & Condition Verification: Develop and execute comprehensive assessment plans to evaluate supplier dunnage fleet calculators, verifying that transit times, shipping frequencies, inventory norms, and logistics parameters align accurately with Ford operating requirements.
* Packaging Sign-Off & Approvals: Serve as the primary liaison between suppliers, purchasing, and plant packaging functions to manage the technical review and secure timely, standardized packaging sign-offs for all new and revised components.
* Container Design & CBM Utilization: Utilize packaging design and simulation tools to optimize shipping container configurations, maximizing cubic meter (CBM) utilization and part packing density to reduce overall freight and piece costs.
* Design for Logistics (DFL) & Localization: Lead "Design for Logistics" initiatives in collaboration with Purchasing and PD by evaluating localization and direct-shipment opportunities to drive down total logistics and packaging spend.
* GPDS Gateway & Business Case Support: Support robust business case development and manage the cost roadmap across GPDS gateways, updating cost models in Ford systems (WERS, WIPS, CMMS3) to identify and mitigate cost risks prior to Job #1.
* TVM & Global Benchmarking: Benchmark packaging designs across North American, European, and IMG facilities to adopt "Best in World" practices, achieving TVM targets through pack-density improvements, sustainable materials, and reduced carbon footprints.

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Industrial, Packaging preferred).
* Experience:4–8+ years of relevant experience in packaging engineering, material flow, logistics, supply chain, or landed cost management.
* Domain Expertise: Experience in the automotive industry—specifically within Powertrain or Vehicle assembly operations—is highly preferred.
* Packaging Optimization Tools: Proficiency in CAD tools (AutoCAD, CATIA) and packaging load simulation / CBM optimization software (CAPE Pack, TOPS, or equivalent).
* Dunnage & Fleet Modeling: Proven ability to build and audit dunnage fleet calculators, loop sizing, inventory norms, and returnable container economics.
* Sourcing & Logistics Terms: Solid understanding of Incoterms, freight costing structures, logistics contracts/terms, and Ford network design principles.
* Process & Systems Knowledge: Familiarity with Ford/automotive MP&L systems (WERS, WIPS, CMMS3, Teamcenter) and gateway milestones (GPDS, APQP, Packaging Sign-Off/PPAP).
* Cost Engineering & TVM: Proven track record in generating TVM / cost reduction ideas, evaluating Total Landed Cost trade-offs (returnable vs. expendable), and supporting business cases.
* Materials & Standards: Strong knowledge of diverse packaging materials (corrugated, steel racks, thermoformed trays, EPP/EPE foam) and sustainable/recyclable packaging solutions, along with industry transit test standards (ISTA/ASTM).
* Analytics & Digital Tools: Strong analytical mindset; proficiency in tools such as Power BI, Looker Studio, Python, Power Apps, or GCP is a strong advantage.
* Soft Skills & Stakeholder Management: Excellent cross-functional collaboration, negotiation, and communication skills to work effectively with Purchasing, Suppliers, Plant Operations, and Leadership.

title: Cloud Services Manager (Container)
description:
Req ID: 142267
  
Remote Position: Hybrid
  
Region: Asia

**Summary**
-----------

Seeking an execution-focused, technically proficient **Manager of Cloud Services** to lead the day-to-day engineering and operations of our multi-cloud ecosystem across **AWS, Azure, and GCP**. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Cloud Architecture & Engineering, you will lead a dedicated squad of cloud, DevOps, and platform engineers tasked with translating high-level architecture designs into robust, production-grade deployments.

You will manage the implementation, maintenance, and reliability of our enterprise container platforms (GKE, AKS, OpenShift, and native Kubernetes), operationalize infrastructure for AI models and agentic workflows, and drive hands-on GitOps and IaC practices. This is an active, technical leadership role requiring direct participation in code reviews, pipeline automation, disaster recovery execution, and operational support.

**Detailed Description**
------------------------

Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following:

* **Blueprint Execution:** Translate multi-cloud architectural frameworks into production-ready infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* **Container Environment Provisioning:** Implement and standardize cluster topologies across Red Hat OpenShift, GKE, AKS, and upstream Kubernetes per architectural guidelines.
* **AI Runtime Infrastructure:** Deploy and support execution infrastructure for machine learning and agentic AI systems (e.g., configuring GPU/TPU nodes, model serving runtimes like vLLM/Triton, vector database clusters, and secure runtime sandboxes for agent execution).
* **IaC Authoring & Review:** Write, review, and maintain production Terraform modules, Helm charts, and raw Kubernetes/Kustomize manifests.
* **GitOps Delivery:** Manage and optimize automated GitOps pipelines using ArgoCD or Flux to ensure version-controlled, continuous deployments across staging and production clusters.
* **Internal Platform Enablement:** Maintain CI/CD pipelines, container registries, and self-service templates enabling software engineering and data science teams to deploy microservices smoothly.
* **Cluster Lifecycle Execution:** Coordinate and execute rolling cluster version upgrades, worker node pool patching, and OS maintenance across multi-cloud Kubernetes fleets with zero service disruption.
* **Capacity & FinOps Tracking:** Monitor resource consumption, configure cluster autoscalers (KEDA, Karpenter), implement pod resource quotas, and track daily compute costs across cloud providers.
* **Vulnerability & Compliance Remediation:** Enforce container base image hardening, automate CVE scanning (Trivy, Grype), and ensure runtime admission controllers (OPA/Gatekeeper/Kyverno) adhere to enterprise standards.
* **Backup Automation:** Implement, test, and manage automated backup routines for Kubernetes cluster states and persistent storage using tools such as Velero or Kasten.
* **Model & Artifact Protection:** Ensure secure, regular backups and snapshot validation for persistent AI datasets, model weights, and state stores.
* **Incident Management & Escalations:** Serve as an operational escalation point for L2/L3 production incidents, directing troubleshooting for container, network, and cloud outages.
* **Telemetry Operations:** Manage centralized logging, metrics, and tracing stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog), configuring actionable alerting rules and dashboards.
* **Root Cause Analysis (RCA):** Lead post-incident retrospectives, track action items to resolution, and implement self-healing automations to avoid recurrence.

**Knowledge/Skills/Competencies**
---------------------------------

* **Multi-Cloud Administration:** Hands-on operational experience with AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (VPC/VNet configuration, IAM roles, cloud storage, security groups).
* **AI & Agentic Workload Enablement:** Practical experience deploying and managing infrastructure supporting AI/LLM workloads, containerized inference runtimes, or AI agent toolsets.
* **Infrastructure as Code & Templating:** Advanced proficiency writing and maintaining Terraform code, Helm charts, and native Kubernetes manifests.
* **GitOps & Automation:** Practical experience configuring and debugging GitOps tools (ArgoCD, Flux) and CI platforms (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
* **Observability:** Strong working knowledge of Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry collectors, and centralized log aggregation tools.
* Leadership**:** Proven track record of managing technical teams and delivering enterprise cloud infrastructure services.

**Physical Demands**
--------------------

* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
* Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

**Typical Experience**
----------------------

* 7 to 10 years of relevant IT experience that shows consistent progression, and at least 5 years hands-on technology and team leadership experience.

**Typical Education**
---------------------

* Bachelor's Degree or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Educational requirements may vary by geography.
* Preferred Qualifications & Certifications

  + **Certifications:**

    - Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
    - Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration
    - Associate or Professional Cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect/SysOps, Azure Administrator, GCP Cloud Engineer)

**Notes**

title: Manager, Network and Infrastructure Reliability
description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

Five9 is rebuilding the operational leadership for its Network & Infrastructure team and needs a hands-on, senior technical manager to take direct ownership of the environment and the team executing the work.

The right candidate will have directly managed production networks at scale, led teams of engineers who build and maintain those systems, and successfully transitioned frontline operations from manual "click-ops" into automated, code-driven execution. If you have not personally managed engineering teams through this specific transition, this is not the right role.

Modernization is already underway, but the current engineering team is short-handed and lacks several critical skills. The person stepping into this role must stabilize daily operations quickly, assess the existing talent, and immediately begin rebuilding both the team and the operating workflows against clear, sprint-level, and measurable milestones.

This is a true player-coach role. You must stay close enough to the technical work to keep your engineering judgment sharp, maintain credibility with senior engineers, and be willing to set the standard by example on the keyboard when needed. At the same time, you must focus on building automated validation gates and upskilling your team so that you can step out of the daily critical path. Carrying a portion of the senior technical load to stabilize the team at the outset is expected; still operating as the primary technical bottle-neck six months in is a failure.

**What success looks like in your first 120 days**

* A working map of the network and infrastructure estate across our DCs and our cloud footprint, plus a clear assessment of your team's capabilities and operational bottlenecks.

* A team skills assessment and a tactical execution plan that details how your team will transition from manual operations to infrastructure/network-as-code, automation, and drift control, balanced against current project deliverables.

* Key engineering hires onboarded successfully, with existing team members actively engaged in cross-training and upskilling programs.

* Early modernization wins visible in production, the on-call and incident load distributed fairly across the team, and you have successfully transitioned from tactical firefighting to guiding team execution.

**What You Bring to Five9**

* A track record of building and leading cohesive teams, raising engineering standards, and shifting daily operations from reactive to proactive, engineering-led execution.

* Experience stabilizing operations and guiding engineering teams through periods of technical change and modernization.

* Strong communication skills backed by operational data, clear risk articulation, and the ability to report measurable outcomes to department leadership.

* Proven ability to build trust, accountability, and a high-performance culture within your engineering team.

* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience partnering closely with software engineering, security, SRE, and product teams.

* Ability to mentor and develop senior engineers and technical leads, driving accountability while establishing clear ownership, operational discipline, and career growth pathways.

* Strong decision-making and prioritization skills in high-pressure production environments with competing operational demands.

* Demonstrated ability to lead teams through ambiguity, align team goals with broader department objectives, and execute complex technical migrations.

* Effective conflict resolution and stakeholder management skills to align technical delivery with business needs.

* Strong operational judgment in network and infrastructure security, with the ability to partner effectively with Security Operations teams.

**What We Require**

* 7+ years of experience in network/infrastructure engineering, with 3+ years directly managing engineering teams in mission-critical, multi-DC production environments.

* Deep technical background in modern DC networking, including OSPF, EVPN, VXLAN, Cisco Nexus, and NX-OS.

* Experience managing infrastructure in a hybrid cloud environment, with a strong focus on supporting GCP workloads.

* Proven success guiding teams to build and adopt network automation and IaC using tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Python, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.

* Hands-on experience modernizing legacy environments by introducing configuration management, drift detection, and policy-based operations where they didn't exist before.

* Strong understanding of network and infrastructure observability using tools such as ThousandEyes, Grafana, Loki, NetFlow, and Netscout to achieve a "single pane of glass" for system health.

* Experience supporting the underlying infrastructure needs of Kubernetes, AI, and GPU workloads.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

Workplace location: This role is fully remote for candidates who reside further than a 30 kilometer driving distance from either our Bangalore or Chennai offices. Candidates who reside within a 30 kilometer driving distance of one of our office locations would be required to work in-office 3 days a week.

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.

Five9 is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@five9.com to request an accommodation. Requests will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law.

View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9.com/pt-pt/legal.

Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9.

description:

From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. **Job Description**
-------------------

**Cloud Automation Engineer**
-----------------------------

**Location:** Mumbai / Noida / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai
  
**Experience:** 6+ Years

### **About the Role**

We are looking for a highly skilled **Cloud Automation Engineer** with strong expertise in Azure Cloud, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automation engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, automating, and managing scalable Azure-based virtual lab environments while driving operational efficiency, reliability, and cost optimization.

### **Your Role**

As a Cloud Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining automated Azure infrastructure solutions, reusable deployment frameworks, and environment lifecycle management capabilities. You will work closely with cloud architects, DevOps teams, and engineering stakeholders to deliver highly automated and repeatable cloud environments.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Automate the creation, configuration, operation, and teardown of Azure-based virtual lab environments.
* Develop reusable **Terraform** and/or **Bicep** modules for Azure infrastructure provisioning.
* Automate deployment of Azure services including Virtual Networks, Subnets, NSGs, Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, Private Connectivity, and Monitoring solutions.
* Create and maintain reusable VM images, deployment artifacts, and infrastructure configurations.
* Develop automation for building, versioning, packaging, validating, publishing, and deploying environment bundles.
* Automate deployment and movement of build, topology, emulator, configuration, and test bundles across virtual machines.
* Implement configuration-driven provisioning based on predefined recipes and topology definitions.
* Develop scripts for environment startup, shutdown, hibernation, health checks, reset, cleanup, and teardown activities.
* Build automation for resource tagging, expiration policies, orphan-resource detection, and cloud cost management.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure provisioning and configuration issues to improve reliability and repeatability.
* Maintain Infrastructure-as-Code repositories, deployment documentation, runbooks, and operational guides.

### **Required Skills & Experience**

* 7+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure Automation, DevOps, or Cloud Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with **Microsoft Azure** services and cloud infrastructure design.
* Expertise in **Terraform** and/or **Azure Bicep** for Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Experience automating Azure networking, compute, storage, security, and monitoring services.
* Strong scripting experience using **PowerShell** , **Python** , or **Bash** .
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
* Knowledge of Azure Virtual Machine image management and environment provisioning.

### **Mandatory Skills**

* Microsoft Azure
* Terraform
* Azure Bicep
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* Azure Networking (VNet, Subnet, NSG)
* Azure Virtual Machines
* Automation Scripting (PowerShell/Python/Bash)
* CI/CD & Deployment Automation
* Cloud Cost Optimization
* Monitoring & Operations

**What You’ll Love About Working Here**

We value flexibility and support our employees with remote work options and adaptable schedules to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
  
Our inclusive culture brings together diverse professionals committed to growth, innovation, and excellence.
  
You’ll have access to continuous learning opportunities and certifications in emerging technologies like cloud and AI.

From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. title: The job opportunity for Network Engineer - Chennai, Bangalore
description:
Network Engineer

Chennai, Bangalore

Full time

Key skills: VXLAN with BGP EVPN, Firewall, Zscaler App Connectors, CCNP, PCNSE,

ospf (open shortest path

Job Description

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Network Engineer to design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot our core enterprise and data center network infrastructure. In this role, you will be directly responsible for managing high-performance networks utilizing VXLAN with BGP EVPN, securing environments using Palo Alto Firewalls, and maintaining reliable site-to-site connectivity. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical expert with deep routing, switching, data center virtualization, and network security expertise.

Key Responsibilities

Data Center Architecture: Design, deploy, and maintain spine-leaf topologies using VXLAN overlay networks with BGP EVPN control planes for scalable, multi-tenant data center environments.

Network Configuration & Switching: Configure and maintain enterprise networks, explicitly managing VLAN segmentation, trunking, inter-VLAN routing, and link aggregation across core and access switches.

Advanced Routing: Implement and optimize dynamic routing protocols, with a heavy focus on BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) configuration, path manipulation, policy routing, and OSPF.

Firewall Management & Security: Deploy, configure, and manage Palo Alto Networks Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), including security policies, NAT rules, threat prevention, and URL filtering.

VPN & Secure Access: Establish, maintain, and monitor secure site-to-site IPsec VPN tunnels connecting remote offices, data centers, and cloud environments, alongside deploying and maintaining Zscaler App Connectors for secure private application access (ZPA).

Troubleshooting & Support: Act as the Tier 3 escalation point to diagnose and resolve complex network connectivity issues, routing loops, asymmetric routing, packet loss, and performance bottlenecks.

Documentation: Author and maintain highly detailed topology diagrams (Logical/Physical), configuration baselines, IP address management (IPAM), and standard operating procedures.

Requirements

Qualifications & Requirements

Experience: Minimum of 4–6 years of dedicated experience in network engineering, network security, or data center infrastructure administration.

Data Center & Routing Skills: Hands-on experience building and supporting VXLAN tunnels and configuring advanced multi-protocol BGP environments.

Firewall Expertise: Deep technical knowledge of administering Palo Alto Firewalls (PAN-OS); experience managing devices via Panorama is highly desirable.

SSE/SASE (Optional/Plus): Familiarity or experience with Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions, specifically configuring and managing Zscaler App Connectors, is a strong plus.

Hardware Familiarity: Proven experience with data center switches supporting EVPN-VXLAN (e.g., Cisco Nexus/NX-OS, Arista EOS, or Juniper Junos).

Certifications (Preferred):

Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP Data Center / Enterprise).

Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer (PCNSE).

Zscaler Certified Cloud Specialist (ZCCS) or Professional (ZCCP).

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical field experience.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Digital S/W Eng Sr Analyst - C12 - CHENNAI
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

* **Job Title / Profile:** Senior Platform Security Engineer
* **Job Family / Function:** Platform Engineering & Information Security
* **Management Level:** Individual Contributor
* **Band / Corporate Title:** C12 (AVP level)
    
    
  **Responsibilities:****Ky Responsibilities:**

  **1. Core Platform Security Gateway & Java Architecture (Team-Specific)**
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  + **Security Gateway Engineering:** Develop, configure, and maintain high-throughput Security Gateway services and reverse-proxy infrastructure (such as PingAccess Security Gateway and containerized OpenShift/ECS microservices).
  + **Authentication Modernization & Federation:** Implement and support enterprise authentication protocols, including SecureSSO, OIDC, COIN tokens, and legacy-to-modern auth migrations (e.g., SiteMinder to COIN/OIDC).
  + **API Routing & Resiliency:** Configure API routing rules downstream from Apigee/APIM, integrate service discovery and manage fault-tolerance mechanisms (circuit breakers, rate limiting) across Green Network environments.
  + **Security & Regulatory Compliance:** Enforce enterprise IAM standards, zero-trust architecture principles, mutual TLS (mTLS), header validation, and ensure all gateway endpoints pass vulnerability and static/dynamic scans.
  + Serve as the Lead Java Engineer driving end-to-end design, implementation, and deployment of mission-critical platform security microservices using **Java (Java 17/21, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Reactive/WebFlux)**. Accountable for executing and driving mid-to-large scale feature application design and development efforts to completion.
  + Operate with considerable autonomy and discretion, significantly influencing application design, concurrency models, thread management, memory optimization, and enterprise design patterns by providing deep subject matter expertise in core Java application programming principles.
  + Act as the primary technical authority sought after for analyzing and troubleshooting complex coding, JVM performance/garbage collection tuning, latency, multithreading, and distributed system design challenges; perform deep root-cause analysis (RCA) and remediate critical defects.
  + Possess a deep, nuanced understanding of technical and architectural requirements, ensuring high reliability, maintainability, scalability, and operational excellence through all phases of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  + Apply advanced expertise in information modeling, data structures, concurrent algorithms, and API schema design to engineer resilient, low-latency microservices and high-throughput security filters.
  + Maintain an in-depth understanding of runtime properties, JVM tuning, hardware/OS sizing, container limits, platform dependencies, and contingencies with upstream and downstream integrations (e.g., token stores, identity providers, and back-end domain services).
  + Demonstrate an advanced understanding of core system flows and how infrastructure components collectively integrate to support business objectives; drive enterprise coding, testing, debugging, and quality standards aligned with Citi's architectural blueprints.
  + Participate in technical design forums as a Development Lead and key decision maker, leveraging deep codebase familiarity, Java best practices, and cross-team architectural insight to guide technical direction.
  + Work with minimal guidance to define delivery strategies and translate complex architectural designs into clean, modular, and maintainable Java source code.
  + Partner with industry vendors and third-party technology providers supporting digital architectures, reviewing technical roadmaps and implementation plans to accelerate development velocity and foster technical innovation.
  + Drive the full SDLC within Agile/Scrum and hybrid frameworks, managing dependencies, defining automated test plans (unit, integration, load, and security testing via JUnit/Mockito/Gatling), and enforcing software quality gates.
  + Directly impact business and technology outcomes by providing expert advice and counsel, effectively persuading and influencing engineering peers and senior leadership through strong technical communication and diplomacy.
  + Proactively identify, assess, track, and mitigate technical risks, anticipate delivery bottlenecks, and lead structured escalation and issue management across multiple project streams.
  + Recognize divergent architectural views, facilitate constructive technical dialog, and drive consensus to achieve alignment on strategic goals.
  + Partner across engineering, platform infrastructure, and DevOps teams to streamline CI/CD pipelines, optimize delivery workflows, and enhance concurrent project execution.
  + Regularly review system health and delivery metrics, establish enhanced visibility mechanisms, and eliminate redundant processes across architecture, build, and production operations environments.
  + Lead engineering brown-bag sessions, mentor junior/mid-level engineers, contribute to internal developer communities, and demonstrate continuous learning through relevant industry certifications.
  + Appropriately assess risk when technical and business decisions are made, safeguarding Citigroup's reputation, client data, and assets by enforcing strict adherence to information security policies, secure coding standards, regulatory mandates, and transparent control issue escalation.

  

**Recommended Qualifications**:

* **10+ years** of professional experience in software engineering, platform security, infrastructure architecture, or technical product delivery environments.
* Proven track record leading and delivering complex, large-scale **enterprise infrastructure and security gateway programs** (e.g., IAM, reverse proxy/gateway layers, microservices, API management).
* Extensive experience delivering robust solutions using **Agile / Scrum / Kanban** methodologies in high-availability, mission-critical environments.

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1736176

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**MLOps / DevOps Engineer**

**AI Platform Engineering, CI/CD, LLMOps and Cloud Operations**

**Career Family AIA - MLOps / DevOps Engineer**

**Role Type Full Time**

  

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an MLOps / DevOps Engineer to build and operate secure, scalable and reliable delivery platforms for AI/ML and Generative AI workloads. The role covers CI/CD, infrastructure as code, container orchestration, model and prompt lifecycle automation, environment management, observability, security, release governance and production support across cloud-native platforms.

The successful candidate should be able to discuss enterprise, pre-production or production implementations, including the business context, individual contribution, technical design, controls, delivery approach and outcomes. Certifications and personal demonstrations supplement, but do not replace, implementation experience.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement CI/CD pipelines for application code, data pipelines, ML models, prompts, agent configurations and infrastructure.
* Build standardized development, test, staging and production environments using infrastructure as code and automated provisioning.
* Containerize AI services and deploy them using Kubernetes, OpenShift, Cloud Run, Azure Container Apps, serverless or equivalent managed platforms.
* Implement model, artifact, dataset, prompt and configuration versioning, lineage, registry and controlled promotion across environments.
* Automate model training, validation, packaging, deployment, rollback, retraining and scheduled or event-driven workflows.
* Enable LLMOps practices for prompt management, model endpoint configuration, evaluation gates, agent releases, observability and cost controls.
* Implement monitoring, logging, distributed tracing, alerting, SLOs and dashboards for infrastructure, APIs, data pipelines, models, retrieval systems and agents.
* Establish security controls covering secrets management, identity and access, network security, image and dependency scanning, vulnerability remediation, audit logging and policy enforcement.
* Design high-availability, backup, disaster recovery, scaling and performance patterns for production AI platforms.
* Integrate source control, artifact repositories, model registries, test automation, quality gates and approval workflows.
* Troubleshoot deployment, networking, IAM, pipeline, container, platform, model-serving and performance issues in collaboration with engineering and security teams.
* Create platform documentation, architecture diagrams, runbooks, operational procedures and release evidence; support incident, change and problem management.
* Promote reusable platform components, self-service templates and DevSecOps standards; coach delivery teams on engineering and operational practices.

  

**Skills and Attributes**

**Professional Experience**

* 4-8 years of experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, data engineering or MLOps.
* Hands-on experience supporting production-grade cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines and containerized workloads.
* Experience operationalizing AI/ML or GenAI solutions, model-serving endpoints, data pipelines or API-based services is strongly preferred.

  

**Cloud and Platform Skills**

* Strong experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS or GCP; working knowledge of its networking, IAM, compute, storage, monitoring and managed AI services.
* Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes or OpenShift; experience with serverless and managed container platforms is beneficial.
* Strong experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, Jenkins or equivalent CI/CD tooling.
* Experience with Terraform, Bicep, ARM, CloudFormation or equivalent infrastructure-as-code tools and configuration management.
* Working knowledge of Linux, shell scripting, Python, YAML, JSON, REST APIs and automation.

  

**MLOps, LLMOps and Operations Skills**

* Understanding of the ML lifecycle, feature and data pipelines, experiment tracking, model registry, model serving, validation, drift, retraining and rollback.
* Exposure to MLflow, Vertex AI, Azure Machine Learning, Amazon SageMaker, Databricks or equivalent AI lifecycle platforms.
* Understanding of LLMOps, prompt and configuration versioning, evaluation gates, vector stores, retrieval services, agent deployments and AI observability.
* Experience with monitoring and logging platforms such as Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Google Cloud Operations, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk or equivalent tools.
* Knowledge of DevSecOps, secrets management, IAM, secure software supply chain, vulnerability scanning, policy as code, auditability and compliance.
* Understanding of reliability engineering, capacity planning, auto-scaling, performance testing, incident response, SLOs, backup and disaster recovery.

  

**Soft Skills**

* Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, documentation and production-support skills.
* Effective collaboration with application, data science, security, infrastructure and client teams.
* Automation-first mindset, attention to operational quality and commitment to continuous improvement.

  

**Education and Preferred Certifications**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Relevant Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Terraform, Databricks, DevOps or AI/ML certifications are preferred.

  

**Why Join Us**

* Be at the forefront of AI-driven innovation across multiple client sectors.
* Work with global clients to deliver measurable business impact.
* Collaborate with AI experts, analytics leaders and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.

  

**What We Offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy.

* Transformative leadership: Gain insights, coaching and confidence to become the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: Use your voice and help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Overview**
------------

### **About us**

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

### **About the role**

**Purpose of the Role :**

The Lead Independent Safety Assessment (ISA) Assessor has the overall authority and responsibility to ensure that all Safety assessment activities under a project are correctly prepared, executed and reported.

The role provides impartial technical judgement on whether safety requirements have been adequately defined, implemented, verified, and justified. Assessing whether risks have been demonstrated to have been reduced to an acceptable level.

**Key Responsibilities :**

* Lead independent safety assessments for railway systems, including signaling, control command, rolling stock, infrastructure, and system integration projects.
* Review and assess safety documentation, including Safety Cases, Hazard Logs, risk assessments, system safety plans, verification and validation evidence, test reports, and assurance arguments.
* Assess compliance with applicable railway safety standards and regulations, including EN 50126, EN 50128 (EN50716), EN 50129 and other project-specific requirements.
* Provide independent technical opinions on the adequacy of safety requirements, risk controls, safety evidence, and residual risk acceptance.
* Plan, manage, and coordinate ISA activities across the project lifecycle, including assessment planning, document review, audits, inspections, test witnessing, findings management, and final reporting.
* Act as the primary technical interface with clients, project teams, design authorities, validators, certification bodies, and regulatory stakeholders.
* Lead multidisciplinary assessment teams, allocate tasks, review outputs, and ensure consistency, quality, and independence of assessment conclusions.
* Identify safety-related issues, observations, and non-compliances, and provide clear recommendations to support timely resolution.
* Prepare high-quality ISA plans, interim assessment reports, findings logs, technical notes, and final ISA reports.
* Maintain impartiality and independence from design, delivery, and implementation activities in accordance with applicable accreditation and governance requirements.

### **What we offer**

DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

### **About you**

**Required Qualification and Experience:**

* Bachelors degree in engineering, systems engineering or safety engineering discipline.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in railways, metros, or trams.
* Specific experience in developing or assessing complex railway signalling systems.
* Minimum 5 years railway safety assurance, independent safety assessment, systems assurance, certification, verification and validation, or safety-critical engineering.
* Demonstrable experience applying railway safety standards, particularly CENELEC standards EN 50126, EN 50128 (EN 50716), and EN 50129, including RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety) specifications and demonstrations. Leading assessment activities for at least 3 complex rail projects, including multidisciplinary systems and interfaces.
* Deep understanding of hazard identification, risk analysis, safety integrity levels, safety requirements management, assurance cases, and lifecycle safety processes.
* Experience engaging with clients, suppliers, infrastructure managers, operators, notified bodies, designated bodies, assessment bodies, and national safety authorities.
* Professional registration, chartered engineer status, or recognized safety/assurance certification is desirable.

**Key Skills and Competencies :**

* Strong understanding of the processes and potential defects related to the lifecycle of the railway’s products
* Knowledge and understanding of risk management, systems engineering and human/organizational factors for the subsystems within scope of assessment
* Knowledge and understanding of the interfaces related to interoperability and safe integration
* Understanding of the risk derived or likely to be derived from the integration of the product into the railway system
* Ability to perform sound robust judgement on any deviation of the product under assessment
* Strong technical judgement and the ability to form clear, evidence-based independent conclusions.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to produce concise, defensible, and audit-ready assessment reports.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and confidence engaging with senior technical, project, and regulatory stakeholders.
* Ability to lead teams, manage priorities, and deliver assessment outputs within agreed scope, schedule, and budget.
* High attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a structured approach to reviewing complex safety evidence.
* Commitment to professional integrity, impartiality, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

  
*Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.*

**Benefits**
------------

Please note that some benefits may vary depending on location, business area, and employment terms. Please confirm with your recruiter.

### **Profit Share**

You’ll be part of our global profit share scheme that means we all share in our success as a business. If we profit, so do you. This will be part of our Total Compensation approach each year and depends on our year-end results.

### **Professional Development**

We believe in the 70/20/10 learning model, where 70% of your learning comes from performing your everyday tasks and working on different projects, new areas and initiatives to gain new skills. 20% from working with others and mentoring and the rest from formal education.

### **Hybrid Work Model**

We work in a hybrid model (three days from the office) and have flexible starting hours. This means you can fit your work and life together in a way that works for you.

### **Global Opportunities**

We support you in exploring different career opportunities or shifting between teams, business areas, or geographies, so that you can shape your career according to what you find motivating.

### **Modern Office in Pune**

Our office in Pune has a modern look and feel and you’ll find zones for both focused work and team integration. Sit/stand desks, high-quality adjustable chairs and balance balls are just a few examples of what ergonomic office means at DNV.

### **Integration Events**

Depending on where you are located, you’ll have the opportunity to participate in offsite meetings as well as different initiatives and fun events at the office. We believe that a well-integrated team is a well-functioning team.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**
-----------------------------------

At DNV, our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is not only an ethical choice, but also a business decision.

Diversity, fairness, and a sense of belonging are a source of strength for our people, our business, and our customers, and help us to deliver on our purpose, vision, and values.

**Lead Network Engineer**
===========================================================================================

**Ready to combine hands-on network engineering with practical team leadership?** We are looking for an experienced Senior Network Engineer with 15 + years who can guide colleagues, coordinate delivery and still enjoy getting close to the technology.

ASSA ABLOY Global IT manages shared infrastructure, global applications and security for globally delivered solutions. We operate in a multi-sourcing environment and work closely with internal customers, strategic partners, suppliers and colleagues across the world.

In this role, you will join the Global IT Network Services organisation, part of the Infrastructure team. Your main focus will be wireless and LAN services, while your wider network perspective will help the team deliver stable, secure and future-ready services.

**About the role**
------------------

You will be a senior technical contributor and a natural team lead for the WiFi and LAN area. You will help the team plan and prioritise work, coordinate technical activities, and ensure consistent and well-aligned delivery.

This is a role where leadership is combined with means stepping away from engineering. You will work hands-on with architecture, design, implementation, troubleshooting and documentation, while coaching colleagues and creating a collaborative, accountable way of working.

You will also act as an important link between engineers, customers, service management and external providers. By turning requirements and operational feedback into practical improvements, you will help develop global network services that provide real business value.

The wider team supports infrastructure services across WiFi, LAN, WAN, Remote Access, DDI, firewalls, load balancing, web security and monitoring, providing opportunities to collaborate broadly between teams.

**To summarise:** You will lead through expertise, teamwork and a strong commitment to hands-on contribution.

  

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Provide day-to-day technical leadership for the team, including planning, prioritisation and coordination of work.
* Coach and support engineers, encourage knowledge sharing and help the team grow its technical capability.
* Acting as a contact for network infrastructure within all the global regions.
* Work closely with customers and colleagues worldwide on service enquiries, incidents, changes and improvements.
* Collect requirements and feedback from customers and stakeholders, then translate them into practical solutions.
* Contribute to common network architecture, design standards, roadmaps and service catalogue development.
* Review service performance, metrics and SLAs, and be able to lead improvement activities when needed.
* Present technical findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Keep processes, operational routines and documentation clear, current and useful.
* Involved and influence in 24/7 operation optimization vs delivery.

**What you bring**
------------------

We are looking for someone with strong technical skills who is confident taking the lead and works well with others. You can organise work in a clear and practical way without adding unnecessary processes. You also understand how to meet today’s operational needs while continuing to improve services for the future.

* Proven experience as a team lead, technical lead or senior engineer who has coordinated and guided others.
* At least ten years of experience in network infrastructure, including significant hands-on work in projects or complex enterprise environments.
* Very strong knowledge of LAN, WiFi, routing and switching.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco wireless technologies, including WLC, Catalyst Center and Cisco ISE.
* Experience working with global service providers, partners and distributed teams.
* A good understanding of service management, SLAs, operational processes and continuous improvement.
* Strong skills in technical design, documentation, troubleshooting and stakeholder communication.
* A customer-focused, structured and proactive approach.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience with agile ways of working.
* Background in customer-facing engineering, consulting, professional services, presales, post-sales or product development.
* Experience contributing to service roadmaps, service catalogues and vendor evaluations.
* Relevant Cisco certifications or equivalent practical expertise.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* A visible role in a global network organisation with the opportunity to influence services used across global regions.
* A combination of technical depth, team leadership and service development.
* Close collaboration with experienced colleagues, customers and strategic technology partners.
* A working environment where practical ideas, clear communication and a positive team spirit matter.

**Location**
------------

* Chennai, India.
* The role is based at the ASSA ABLOY office.

  

**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
  
Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.

As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.

title: Systems Engineering SPECIALIST - SCCM/Intune
description:
**Req ID:** 392090
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering SPECIALIST - SCCM/Intune to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
POSITION DETAILS
  
**Job Title:** SCCM/Intune Engineer – Endpoint Management
  
**Location:** India — Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai / Noida (Hybrid)
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time (Permanent)
  
**Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in enterprise endpoint management with demonstrated proficiency in both Microsoft Intune and ManageEngine, preferably in a managed services or IT outsourcing environment.
  
**Compensation:** Competitive CTC commensurate with experience. Benefits include health insurance (self and family), PF, gratuity, variable performance bonus, leave travel allowance (LTA), and professional certification support.
  
**Work Hours:** IST - aligned shifts; flexibility required for global client coverage
  
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
We are seeking a skilled SCCM/Intune Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This mid-level role involves independently managing end-to-end endpoint lifecycle operations. We are looking for a dedicated ManageEngine Patch Management Engineer to take full ownership of our endpoint security compliance and automated patching lifecycle. In this role, you will manage, configure, and maintain our deployment of ManageEngine Patch Manager Plus (or Endpoint Central patching modules). Your primary goal will be to secure our enterprise environment by systematically deploying OS updates and keeping third-party applications up to date to minimize our corporate vulnerability footprint.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
OS Deployment Image Management
  

* Design, build, and maintain Windows 10/11 OSD task sequences using SCCM/MDT integration for global client environments.
* Manage WinPE boot images, driver packages, and deployment boundaries for OSD operations.
* Support OS refresh, wipe-and-reload, and in-place upgrade deployment scenarios.
* Troubleshoot OSD failures including PXE boot issues, task sequence errors, and driver conflicts.
* Contribute to Windows Autopilot profile configuration and deployment for Intune-managed devices.
* Maintain image documentation including build standards, versioning, and patch currency records.

Patch Management
  

* Automated Patch Deployment (APD): Design, configure, and manage Patch Manager Plus workflows to automate the entire patching lifecycle—from vulnerability database synchronization to final deployment.
* Cross-Platform OS Management: Oversee scheduled and critical patching for a heterogeneous network environment encompassing Windows Endpoints.
* Third-Party Application Patching: Package, test, and push updates for an extensive catalog of supported third-party enterprise software (e.g., Adobe, Java, web browsers, and productivity suites).
* Test Approve Testing Ring Processes: Establish strict deployment policies using non-production test groups to verify patch stability before pushing updates into the production environment.
* Decline Exclude Rule Management: Review security advisories and selectively decline patches that cause known infrastructure conflicts or are incompatible with legacy enterprise software.
* Compliance Reporting: Utilize the Patch Manager dashboard to generate real-time compliance audits, vulnerability summaries, and endpoint patching health reports for executive leadership.

Application Software Management
  

* Manage complex application deployments using SCCM applications with detection methods, requirements, and dependencies.
* Package enterprise applications using .intunewin format and deploy via Intune with advanced targeting.
* Support software metering, asset intelligence, and license management activities in SCCM.
* Design and implement application supersedence and uninstall workflows.
* Collaborate with app packaging teams to validate and test packaged software before production deployment.

Infrastructure Platform Management
  

* Monitor and maintain SCCM site server health, DP replication, and component status for client environments.
* Manage Intune connector, certificate infrastructure, and Intune service health.
* Develop PowerShell scripts for endpoint automation, reporting, and operational efficiency improvements.
* Handle L2/L3 escalations with thorough root cause analysis and permanent fix documentation.
* Participate in change management, CAB reviews, and client operational governance calls during IST business hours.

REQUIRED SKILLS
  

* Microsoft Intune — device management, compliance, WUfB, Win32 app deployment, Autopilot
* ManageEngine — patch management
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — OSD, applications, collections, and reporting (proficient)
* Windows 10/11 image management — task sequences, WinPE, driver management, MDT integration
* Azure AD and Hybrid Azure AD join configurations, conditional access, and co-management
* PowerShell scripting for automation, reporting, and endpoint remediation
* SQL/WQL queries for SCCM inventory and compliance reporting
* ITSM operations — incident, problem, and change management (ServiceNow or equivalent)
* Strong written and spoken English for client-facing delivery and documentation

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent
* Experience with SCCM-to-Intune co-management and workload migration
* Exposure to Qualys, Tenable, or vulnerability management integration with EPM
* Experience in NTT DATA, Infosys, Wipro, TCS, HCL, or similar IT outsourcing delivery models

MINIMUM EDUCATION
  
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc. IT/CS) or MCA from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent experience and industry certifications will be considered.
  
NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, religion, caste, gender, nationality, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable Indian law.

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. title: T&T - Engineering - Manager - Data Modeller - Bengaluru
description:
**T&T - Engineering - Manager - Data Modeller - Bengaluru**
  
• **Job requisition ID** : 111702
  
• **Location**: Pune
  
• **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The Team**

  

Deloitte’s Technology & Transformation practice can help you uncover and unlock the value buried deep inside vast amounts of data. Our global network provides strategic guidance and implementation services to help companies manage data from disparate sources and convert it into accurate, actionable information that can support fact-driven decision-making and generate an insight-driven advantage. Our practice addresses the continuum of opportunities in business intelligence & visualization, data management, performance management and next-generation analytics and technologies, including big data, cloud, cognitive and machine learning.

  

**Your Work Profile**

  

The **Data Modeler** is responsible for designing, maintaining, and governing enterprise-wide data models that support business operations, analytics, regulatory reporting, and digital transformation initiatives. This role works closely with business stakeholders, architects, data engineers, and governance teams to ensure data structures are scalable, consistent, and aligned with organizational standards and business objectives.

  

**Key Skills & Competencies**

  

* Design and maintain **Conceptual, Logical, and Physical Data Models** for enterprise data platforms.

* Analyse business requirements and translate them into robust, scalable, and future-ready data models.

* Design enterprise-wide data models across Banking and Financial Services domains such as Customer, Accounts, Deposits, Loans, Payments, Cards, Risk, Compliance, and Regulatory Reporting.

* Define entities, attributes, relationships, keys, constraints, and business rules.

* Develop dimensional, normalized, and denormalized data models for operational and analytical workloads.

* Collaborate with Business Analysts, Data Architects, Solution Architects, Data Engineers, and Governance teams to achieve a unified data architecture.

* Create and maintain data dictionaries, metadata repositories, business glossaries, and lineage documentation.

* Ensure compliance with enterprise data standards, naming conventions, reference architectures, and governance frameworks.

* Support design of Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, Data Marts, and Modern Data Platforms on cloud environments.

* Review source-to-target mappings and validate data structures against business and regulatory requirements.

* Identify data quality issues, redundancies, inconsistencies, and recommend remediation approaches.

* Participate in data migration, modernization, integration, and transformation initiatives.

* Optimize data models for scalability, performance, security, and maintainability.

* Support Master Data Management (MDM), Reference Data Management, and Data Governance initiatives.
