title: Senior Security Architect
description:
Overview:

Expleo is a trusted partner for end-to-end, integrated engineering, quality services, and management consulting for digital transformation. We help businesses harness technological change to deliver innovation, improve resilience, and support the secure delivery of complex products, platforms, and systems.

As part of the Expleo UK Cybersecurity Practice, you will join a managed Cyber Operations service for a major UK energy network operator that forms part of the UK's Critical National Infrastructure (CNI). The service is governed by Expleo in the UK, with a 24/7 UK Security Operations Centre delivered by a specialist partner and an Expleo consultancy team in India providing design, engineering and assurance expertise across the client's security tooling estate.

As **Senior Security Architect**, you will be the senior technical adviser within the offshore consultancy team. Working under the technical direction of the UK Head of Service, who holds design authority, you will produce the security architecture, design and risk material that underpins the service, and provide technical leadership to the offshore engineers.

**This is a design, review and advisory role.** You will work within Expleo's offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK-based, security-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through Expleo's controlled UK service boundary.

Responsibilities:

**Responsibilities**

* Produce and maintain security architecture and design documentation (high-level and low-level designs) for the client's security tooling estate, for approval by the UK Head of Service.
* Carry out architecture and risk reviews of proposed high-risk changes (firewall, intrusion prevention, gateway, privileged access and application control) before they are presented to the client's Change Advisory Board.
* Define logging and audit requirements for in-scope security tools, including log sources, feed requirements for the client's retained SIEM, and a retention architecture aligned with client policy and regulatory obligations.
* Assess and recommend tooling and approaches for PKI and secrets management.
* Produce NIS Regulations and NCSC Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF) alignment assessments and contribute evidence to the client's regulatory reporting.
* Prepare inputs for the client's governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) reporting on the enterprise's security status.
* Develop risk treatment plans in line with client policy and industry best practice and maintain inputs to the security risk register.
* Prepare technical content and risk papers for the client's cyber security governance board, in support of the UK Head of Service and the Lead Information Risk Manager.
* Maintain the master set of security architecture diagrams and ensure that diagrams produced by the engineering team are consistent and up to date.
* Identify and assess continual improvement opportunities, including benefit-cost appraisal and sequencing into quick wins, foundational change and strategic uplift.
* Apply appropriate consideration of operational technology (OT) and IT/OT boundary risk in all architecture and design work.
* Provide technical leadership, peer review and mentoring to the Lead Security Engineer, Security Engineers and Vulnerability and Patch Manager.
* Support the growth of Expleo's Cybersecurity Practice through knowledge sharing, technical contribution and client-facing delivery excellence.

Qualifications:

* Degree in computer science, cybersecurity, information systems or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* CISSP, CISSP-ISSAP or SABSA Chartered Foundation (at least one required).
* TOGAF, a cloud security certification (e.g. CCSP, AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty) or GICSP/ISA/IEC 62443 certification would be advantageous.

Essential skills:

* Enterprise security architecture across network, identity, endpoint, cloud and data security domains.
* Designing logging and SIEM integration architectures, including log source definition and retention requirements.
* Applying risk assessment methods such as ISO/IEC 27005 and NIST SP 800-30.
* Working knowledge of the NIS Regulations, NCSC CAF, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF and CIS Controls.
* Reviewing proposed changes for architectural and security risk, and producing clear, evidence-based recommendations.
* Excellent written communication for executive, governance and regulator-facing documentation.

Ability to lead and quality-assure the work of other engineers

Desired skills:

* Energy, utilities or other CNI sector experience.
* Knowledge of OT/ICS security concepts, the Purdue model and IEC 62443.
* Experience with GRC tooling (e.g. ServiceNow IRM, Archer).
* Experience with Ofgem or NIS-regulated cyber assurance activity.

Experience:

* 12+ years in IT and cybersecurity, including 6+ years in security architecture for enterprise or CNI environments.
* Experience producing architecture, design and risk artefacts for regulated organisations.
* Experience supporting governance boards, risk registers and GRC reporting.
* Experience working with multi-supplier environments and managed security service providers.

What do I need before I apply:

* Have the right to work in India.
* Be based in, or willing to relocate to, Chennai.
* Be willing to complete Expleo enhanced pre-employment background screening *(equivalent in standard to the UK Baseline Personnel Security Standard)* and any additional vetting the client requires.
* Be able to work hours that overlap with the UK business day, with occasional out-of-hours advisory support during major incidents.
* Have excellent written and spoken English, suitable for engagement with senior UK stakeholders.
* Be comfortable working within a strict security boundary, with no access to the client's operational systems or data.

Benefits:

* Collaborative working environment: we stand shoulder to shoulder with our clients and our peers through good times and challenges.
* We empower all passionate, technology-loving professionals to expand their skills and take part in inspiring projects.
* Expleo Academy enables you to acquire and develop the right skills by delivering a suite of accredited training courses.
* Competitive local company benefits *[India HR to confirm the benefits package].*
* Always working as one team, our people are not afraid to think big and challenge the status quo.

“We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.”

If you are an experienced Security Architect with a strong background in enterprise and CNI security architecture, and you enjoy shaping how critical services are secured, we encourage you to apply today.

Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or higher with minimum 06 years of relevant experience  
  
Job Summary  
Experience Required: 6–9+ Years  
  
Job Summary  
We are seeking a high caliber Senior AS/400 (IBM i) Systems Administrator / Infrastructure Engineer (L3 Support) to serve as the senior technical authority for our enterprise IBM Power Systems platform. In this lead engineering role, you will be responsible for platform architecture, operating system upgrades, virtualization design, deep tier incident forensics, high availability/disaster recovery (HA/DR) design, storage engineering, and performance optimization.  
The successful candidate will act as the final internal escalation tier for mission critical IBM i infrastructure incidents, drive complex OS migrations across releases (IBM i 7.3, 7.4, and 7.5), architect PowerVM and VIOS environments, optimize enterprise storage configurations (IASP, SAN integration), and orchestrate automated HA/DR replication architectures (PowerHA, MIMIX). This role focuses purely on system architecture, operating system engineering, security hardening, and infrastructure resilience, serving as the technical liaison to IBM Support (PMR/Escalations), enterprise architects, and executive IT management.  
  
  
Key Responsibilities  
1. Level 3 Escalation, Deep Diagnostics & Root Cause Analysis (RCA)  
  
. Serve as the supreme technical escalation authority for severe (P1/Major) system outages, abnormal IPLs, kernel exceptions, hung partitions, and machine check conditions.  
. Conduct advanced system crash investigations using System Service Tools (SST), Dedicated Service Tools (DST), Main Storage Dumps (MSD), and LIC trace analysis.  
. Interrogate advanced logs (PAL, QHST, Advanced Job Logs) to diagnose complex intermittent hardware faults, bus channel errors, and memory corruptions.  
. Own and author definitive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation; engineer preventative architecture changes to permanently eliminate systemic failure modes.  
. Manage and drive complex technical support cases (PMRs / IBM Support Cases), coordinating directly with IBM Level 3 labs and Rochester development teams.  
  
2. Operating System Lifecycle, Version Migrations & PTF Engineering  
  
. Architect, plan, and execute major OS release upgrades (e.g., migrations from IBM i 7.3/7.4 to 7.5) and Technology Refresh (TR) cycles across large scale enterprise estates.  
. Formulate comprehensive PTF management policies; perform cross subsystem prerequisite/corequisite analysis, microcode/firmware compatibility matrices, and regression risk assessments.  
. Manage system level configurations including dynamic tuning system values, Workload Groups, Subsystem Descriptions (SBSD), Class parameters, and memory pool allocations.  
. Oversee system initialization scripts, startup programs (QSTRUP), subsystem routing architectures, and operational configurations.  
  
3. Power Systems Architecture, PowerVM & VIOS Engineering  
  
. Architect, configure, and maintain enterprise IBM Power Systems hardware (Power9, Power10) managed via redundant Hardware Management Consoles (HMC).  
. Design and implement PowerVM virtualization solutions, including Virtual I/O Server (VIOS) clustering, Shared Ethernet Adapter (SEA) failover, and N\_Port ID Virtualization (NPIV) SAN mapping.  
. Engineer enterprise LPAR topology, configuring shared processor pools, capped/uncapped partitions, Virtual Processors, and dynamic processor/memory optimization.  
. Lead HMC firmware lifecycles, service processor firmware upgrades, and disaster recovery replication for HMC configurations.  
  
4. Enterprise HA/DR Architecture & Disaster Recovery Orchestration  
  
. Design, implement, and fine tune enterprise High Availability (HA) replication architectures using solutions such as Precisely MIMIX, IBM PowerHA SystemMirror, or Maxava HA.  
. Architect journal environments: Remote Journaling (RJ), asynchronous/synchronous network transport, dual journal receivers, and threshold management.  
. Architect and lead scheduled enterprise Disaster Recovery (DR) and full role swap (switchover / failover) tests, guaranteeing stringent Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).  
. Develop and maintain automated failover scripts, audit validation procedures, and emergency split brain recovery playbooks.  
  
5. Storage Engineering, IASP & Resiliency Architecture  
  
. Architect auxiliary storage topologies, balancing internal NVMe/SAS drives and external SAN arrays (IBM FlashSystem, DS8000) using San Volume Controller (SVC).  
. Implement and manage Independent Auxiliary Storage Pools (IASP) to isolate databases for modular switchover and flash copy operations.  
. Formulate enterprise wide BRMS (Backup, Recovery, and Media Services) architecture, including network synced BRMS clusters, media lifecycle policies, and VTL encryption.  
. Author and validate bare metal disaster recovery procedures, cold start installation plans, and full scale recovery runs (SAVSYS / Option 21 rebuilds).  
  
6. Advanced Performance Tuning, Profiling & Capacity Planning  
  
. Conduct deep tier system performance profiling utilizing IBM i Performance Data Investigator (PDI), Collection Services, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, and IBM i Doctor.  
. Optimize system memory allocation by tuning dynamic system values (QPFRADJ), defining private memory pools, and resolving object lock contention.  
. Analyze disk subsystem bottlenecks, arm contention, queue depths, and optimize paging space allocation.  
. Formulate multi year capacity planning models predicting CPU (CPW), memory, and SAN storage expansion aligned with corporate business growth.  
  
7. Security Hardening, Audit Forensics & Compliance Architecture  
  
. Architect and enforce OS security hardening in accordance with IBM i Security Level 40 and 50 standards.  
. Establish comprehensive security auditing architectures via QAUDJRN, configuring journal filters for security critical actions and unauthorized object manipulation.  
. Implement adopted authority controls, secure system values (QSECURITY, QPWD\*, QALWUSRDMN), and service program access controls.  
. Drive compliance and vulnerability management programs (SOX, PCI DSS, ISO 27001), designing automated scripts to remediate non compliant configurations.  
  
8. Infrastructure Automation, Modernization & Technical Mentorship  
  
. Architect reusable operational automation utilizing advanced Control Language (CL) programs and modern Db2 for i / IBM i Services (QSYS2).  
. Evaluate and implement modern administration frameworks, such as IBM i open source integration (PASE, Bash, Python), Ansible for IBM i automation, and REST APIs.  
. Serve as the technical mentor and escalation lead for L1 and L2 system administrators, conducting peer technical reviews and establishing enterprise engineering standards.  
. Participate in architectural review boards (ARB) for major business applications and enterprise infrastructure projects.  
  
Key skills :  
Backup strategies, disaster  
Recovery plans  
Performance tuning,  
Capacity/resource planning  
Data Restoration  
System Upgrades  
  
  
Required Qualifications  
  
. Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent industry experience.  
. Experience: Minimum of 6–10+ years of dedicated, hands on enterprise experience in IBM i (AS/400) System Engineering, Power Systems Architecture, and L3 Support.  
. Environment Experience: Proven track record architecting and supporting large scale enterprise environments (30+ LPARs, multi system Power9/Power10 estates, petabyte scale storage, and critical transaction banking/retail/logistics systems).  
  
  
Required Technical Skills  
  
. Operating System Mastery: Deep internal architecture knowledge of IBM i (releases 7.2 through 7.5), LIC, SLIC, Microcode, Machine Check handling, and SST/DST forensics.  
. OS Migration & Lifecycle: Proven leadership in executing complex OS release upgrades (e.g., 7.3 > 7.4 > 7.5) and comprehensive Technology Refresh (TR) deployments.  
. Hardware & Virtualization: Advanced architecture experience with IBM Power9/Power10, redundant HMCs, PowerVM, dual VIOS configurations, NPIV, SEA, and dynamic LPAR allocation.  
. High Availability & DR: Mastery of enterprise HA solutions: MIMIX or PowerHA SystemMirror; comprehensive design of Remote Journals, data synchronization engines, and full site to site role swaps.  
. Storage & Resiliency: Architecture of IASP, SAN attached storage (SVC/FlashSystem), Multipath I/O, bare metal restore procedures, and enterprise wide BRMS network cluster management.  
. Deep Diagnostics & Performance: Proficiency with Collection Services, Performance Tools (PT1), PDI, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, IBM i Doctor, and MSD analysis.  
. Security & Auditing: Security Level 40/50 enforcement, deep QAUDJRN forensics, authorization list architecture, and audit remediation.  
. Automation: Advanced CL programming, complex QSYS2 / Db2 for i SQL Services, and exposure to Ansible for IBM i or shell scripting.  
. Service Frameworks: Mature understanding of ITIL Problem Management, Change Governance, and Architectural Standards.  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications

. Certified High Availability Professional (e.g., Precisely Certified MIMIX Professional).  
. Direct experience architecting IBM i within Hybrid Cloud environments (e.g., IBM Power Virtual Server / PowerVS on IBM Cloud).  
. Deep experience in Ansible automation for IBM i system administration.  
. ITIL Intermediate or Expert Certification.  
  
  
Key Competencies  
  
. Masterful Diagnostic Mindset: Exceptional ability to deconstruct complex, multi tiered infrastructure failures spanning OS, hypervisor, SAN, network, and application code.  
. Decisive Crisis Leadership: Ability to take total technical command during critical production outages and execute high risk recovery actions under executive visibility.  
. Strategic Infrastructure Vision: Capacity to balance immediate operational reliability with multi year modernization and platform automation goals.  
. Technical Mentorship & Advocacy: Passion for uplifting team capabilities, mentoring L2 engineers, and evangelizing modern IBM i administrative patterns.e zones.boration with global engineering teams and operational hubs across multiple time zones.

**Simplicity at Scale.**  
  
How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as #OneSectigo by living out our core values - Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. **Job Description**
-------------------

We are looking for a talented Senior Engineering Manager join our growing global team at Sectigo.

The Senior Engineering Manager will build and drive integration engineering capability from our India GCC. This team owns our engineering-led approach to third-party and platform integrations, starting with our ServiceNow implementation and a new pilot integrating PSA (Professional Services Automation) marketplace platforms into our core platform. This leader is genuinely AI-native by integrating AI tools daily in how we code, test, document, and make decisions.  
  
Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:

  

* Define team structure and hiring plan for a new Integration Engineering org in Chennai.
* Own a blended workforce model: manage specialized consultants and a contracting team, with a contract-to-hire approach as the default and direct hiring for key roles where warranted.
* Recruit, onboard, and develop engineers; set the technical bar and team culture from day one. Own integration engineering delivery
* Take ownership of the ServiceNow workstream already underway, including a candid retrospective on what hasn't worked so far.
* Stand up the engineering model for the Pax8/ConnectWise marketplace/PSA integration pilot, in partnership with specialized consultants and the core platform team.
* Build this into a repeatable capability as the integration portfolio grows beyond these two initiatives. Define the operating model with core platform engineering
* Partner directly with the core platform engineering leadership to define architecture and integration patterns, required APIs/workflows, source-code access boundaries, development standards, and the technical point-of-contact model between teams.
* Push for a model where the core platform team focuses on the platform and exposes clean APIs/capabilities, while your team builds and owns integrations on top not one where core teams build every integration themselves. Lead as an AI-native engineering manager
* Use AI tools yourself, day to day for design exploration, code review, testing, documentation, and even parts of people/project management and set that as the visible norm for the team, not an optional add-on.
* Build documentation, API contracts, and integration patterns that are discoverable and usable by AI agents, not just humans.
* Create an engineering environment where AI increasingly assists with implementation, testing, validation, documentation, and knowledge transfer this is a core operating principle for the org from day one, not a future aspiration.
* Actively evaluate and introduce new AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows as they emerge, rather than waiting for direction from above. Operate as a proactive, senior engineering leader
* Work through ambiguity: propose structure, process, and scope rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.
* Partner closely with Product for visibility and alignment, while keeping engineering ownership and decision-making inside engineering.
* Provide regular updates, risks, and recommendations to senior (US-based) engineering leadership, including workforce and contract-to-hire decisions.
* Maintain meaningful overlap with US working hours for real-time collaboration with distributed stakeholders, architects, and product partners.
* Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.

More information about this role:

* This is a full-time and in-office position, reporting to our Chennai office 5 days a week.
* This individual may manage a team and will be reporting directly to our General Manager, Chennai Center of Excellence.
* The targeted compensation package for this role is between INR 55,00,000 LPA and INR 75,00,000 LPA. We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or Engineering; platform or vendor certifications (e.g., ServiceNow, cloud platform, or API-management certifications) is strongly recommended.

**Experience:**

* Minimum 8+ years in software, systems, or integration engineering, including experience directly managing engineers (as an EM, or as a senior/staff engineer with clear, demonstrable people leadership experience) is required.
* Track record of building or scaling a team from the ground up ideally in a GCC, global captive, or new-site environment, not just growing an existing, well-defined team.
* Hands-on design and administration of API/integration platforms ServiceNow, MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Azure Integration Services, or comparable including workflow, connector, and access design is required.
* Familiarity with the PSA (Professional Services Automation) ecosystem tools like ConnectWise, Autotask, Kaseya, or similar and how MSPs/partners consume vendor integrations through them.
* Integration design fundamentals: API contract design, data mapping and transformation, authentication patterns, and designing clean ownership boundaries and handoffs between systems and teams.
* AI-native, hands-on daily, practical use of AI tools in your own workflow (AI coding assistants, agentic dev tools, AI for documentation/testing), with the disposition to keep learning as the tooling changes, in line with our AI-DLC direction.
* ITSM/ticketing and collaboration tooling ServiceNow (or an equivalent ITSM tool) and the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence) for engineering workflow, tracking, and documentation.
* Experience operating in environments with formal change management, compliance requirements, and high security standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001) directly relevant given Sectigo's security/PKI domain.
* Genuine comfort with ambiguity able to create structure, process, and scope where none exists yet, without needing constant top-down direction.
* Ability to establish priorities and work independently with minimal supervision across time zones, with meaningful overlap with US business hours (e.g., available into the evening IST for standups, architecture reviews, and leadership syncs).
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across time zones, functions, and seniority levels.

**Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications:**

* An established practice of using an AI assistant inside your engineering workflow change review, log analysis, documentation drafting.
* Relational databases and reporting/BI tools; directory services and access management (Active Directory or equivalent); general network and security concepts relevant to integration architecture.
* PKI and certificate management particularly relevant given Sectigo's core business.
* Prior experience setting up or leading a team inside a Global Capability Center (GCC) in India.
* Experience with contract-to-hire staffing models specifically in the India market.
* Broader background in cybersecurity or certificate/identity infrastructure.

title: Vulnerability and Patch Manager
description:
Overview:

Expleo is a trusted partner for end-to-end, integrated engineering, quality services, and management consulting for digital transformation. We help businesses harness technological change to deliver innovation, improve resilience, and support the secure delivery of complex products, platforms, and systems.

As part of the Expleo UK Cybersecurity Practice, you will join a managed Cyber Operations service for a major UK energy network operator that forms part of the UK's Critical National Infrastructure (CNI). The service is governed by Expleo in the UK, with a 24/7 UK Security Operations Centre delivered by a specialist partner and an Expleo consultancy team in India providing design, engineering and assurance expertise across the client's security tooling estate.

As **Vulnerability and Patch Manager**, you will lead the vulnerability intelligence, prioritisation and patch advisory service across the client's server, end-user, network and security device estate, coordinating remediation through the client's operational teams and suppliers.

**This is a design, review and advisory role.** You will work within Expleo's offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK-based, security-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through Expleo's controlled UK service boundary.

Responsibilities:

**Responsibilities**

* Lead a continuous vulnerability assessment programme, using outputs from the client's vulnerability management platform released through the UK service boundary.
* Prioritise vulnerabilities using threat-informed criteria (CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, NCSC advisories and vendor PSIRTs) and produce monthly remediation recommendations.
* Issue critical patch advisories, typically within 24 hours, based on client guidance and credible threat intelligence, to enable expedited remediation by UK-based personnel and client suppliers.
* Produce a monthly report on vendor patch and firmware releases across the server, end-user, mobile, network and security estate.
* Produce OS patch and device firmware compliance reports.
* Consolidate patch and upgrade status reporting for firewalls, intrusion prevention, email gateway, secure web gateway and application control platforms.
* Track intrusion prevention signature (digital vaccine) compliance against the 48-hour target, working with the Security Engineer | Network.
* Maintain the vulnerability exception and risk acceptance register and present items for decision through service governance.
* Prepare and co-facilitate the monthly vulnerability and patch review with the UK Head of Service, client teams and third-party suppliers.
* Carry out targeted vulnerability analysis in support of incidents and investigations when directed.
* Apply safe practice for operational technology (OT) assets, where scanning and patching are constrained.
* Support the growth of Expleo's Cybersecurity Practice through knowledge sharing and technical contribution.

Qualifications:

* Degree in computer science, cybersecurity or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Vulnerability management vendor certification, e.g. Rapid7, Tenable or Qualys (at least one required).
* CompTIA CySA+, PenTest+, GIAC GEVA, or ITIL 4 Foundation would be advantageous.

Essential skills:

* Vulnerability management platforms (e.g. Rapid7 InsightVM, Tenable, Qualys) and interpretation of their outputs.
* Patch management processes and tooling (e.g. Intune/MECM, Ivanti, Tanium, BigFix).
* Threat-informed prioritisation using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV and vendor advisories.
* Coordinating remediation across internal teams and third-party suppliers.
* Strong reporting and data analysis (Excel, Power BI).
* Clear, concise written advisories for technical and non-technical audiences.

Desired skills:

* OT vulnerability management and safe scanning practice.
* Energy, utilities or other CNI sector experience.
* Experience supporting NIS or CAF-aligned assurance reporting.

Experience:

* 8-12 years in IT security or infrastructure, including 4+ years managing vulnerability and patch management programmes.
* Experience running risk exception and acceptance processes through governance.

What do I need before I apply:

* Have the right to work in India.
* Be based in, or willing to relocate to, Chennai.
* Be willing to complete Expleo enhanced pre-employment background screening *(equivalent in standard to the UK Baseline Personnel Security Standard)* and any additional vetting the client requires.
* Be able to work hours that overlap with the UK business day, with occasional out-of-hours advisory support during major incidents.
* Have excellent written and spoken English, suitable for engagement with senior UK stakeholders.
* Be comfortable working within a strict security boundary, with no access to the client's operational systems or data.

Benefits:

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Engineering Lead is a senior technology delivery professional responsible for driving the successful end-to-end delivery of complex products and features. This role provides technical leadership across multiple squads, ensures engineering excellence, and partners closely with Product, Architecture, and Business stakeholders to meet strategic outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**  
• Lead and support the formulation of technology strategy across the product domain, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and business priorities
  
• Drive ownership of the product-suite strategy alongside Product Owners and Business stakeholders, ensuring prioritization and alignment with delivery outcomes
  
• Shape technology roadmaps, architectural direction, and long-term engineering plans to support sustainable delivery
  
• Oversee and contribute to budgeting, demand planning, and resource forecasting for engineering needs, ensuring transparent reporting and trade-off discussions

**Business**  
• Champion engineering excellence and implement best-practice delivery methods across squads, ensuring predictable and high-quality outcomes
  
• Partner with Business, Product, and Architecture leads to translate business needs into feasible delivery plans and scalable technical solutions
  
• Promote an environment of innovation, encouraging teams to leverage modern engineering patterns and tools to solve business challenges
  
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across engineering practices, delivery processes, and technical operations
  
• Ensure solutions adhere to enterprise architecture standards and support long-term technology sustainability
  
• Foster strong cross-functional collaboration, providing leadership that reinforces accountability, ownership, and engineering craftsmanship

**Process**  
• Oversee and continuously refine engineering processes to ensure efficient, predictable, and transparent delivery across all squads
  
• Enable timely and quality delivery of releases by ensuring disciplined sprint planning, dependency management, and effective removal of blockers
  
• Drive adoption of standardized eSDLC practices and ensure compliance with architectural, security, and operational guidelines
  
• Identify and implement improvements in engineering effectiveness, tooling, automation, and ways of working to maximize squad efficiency
  
• Ensure accurate and timely reporting of delivery metrics, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders
  
• Manage relationships and performance of technology vendors, ensuring value and alignment to engineering expectations
  
• Promote best practices in data management and governance to support reliable product delivery
  
• Guides engineering quality by defining evaluation criteria, enforcing best-practice AI tooling, and validating technical user stories, fixes, and core functionality enhancements.
  
**People & Talent**  
• Take on Chapter Leadership as an active practitioner in the craft of the Chapter that they lead, i.e., has full accountability to the growth of the Chapter, and not solely a line management responsibility.
  
• Provide strong leadership to engineering teams, fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, and high performance
  
• Actively engage in mentoring and capability uplift, strengthening technical skills, delivery discipline, and career development across squads
  
• Support hiring, onboarding, and talent development to build a resilient and skilled engineering workforce
  
• Promote a safe, inclusive, and collaborative environment, enabling teams to innovate and deliver their best work
  
• Ensure engineering teams adhere to craftsmanship principles and maintain high standards of code quality, testing, and design
  
• Optimizes AI knowledge reuse and consumption by identifying reusable capabilities and uplifting engineering skills across the hive.

**Risk Management**  
• Identify, manage, and mitigate delivery risks and issues proactively, ensuring timely escalation and resolution
  
• Ensure squads adopt appropriate testing, code reviews, security controls, and architecture governance practices
  
• Maintain strict adherence to eSDLC processes, ensuring high-quality engineering outputs and predictable delivery
  
• Promote safe delivery through proper documentation, change management, and quality assurance practices
  
**Governance**  
• Address tech compliance (ESDLC) requirements through the delivery lifecycle (design reviews, security reviews, SAT, OAT, etc.) with support from HTL(Hive Tech Lead) / PO / CPO (Chief Product Owner)
  
• Ensure compliance with regulatory, operational, and enterprise governance standards across all engineering work
  
• Support audits, oversight reviews, and risk committees with accurate and timely reporting
  
• Drive adherence to engineering governance frameworks, including architecture governance, risk controls, security requirements, and delivery standards
  
• Contribute to and participate in governance forums to represent engineering delivery health, risks, and strategic needs
  
• Evaluates & refines AI-generated requirements / technical artefacts, ensuring strategic alignment, feasibility, & adherence to standards.

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

* 10+ years experinece in software engineering
* **Java & Back-end Engineering** Strong hands-on Java engineering experience, with a solid understanding of modern Java, Spring/Spring Boot, concurrency, application performance, dependency management, and building maintainable enterprise back-end services.
* **API & Service Development** Strong experience designing, building and evolving REST APIs and service-based architectures. Able to make good decisions around API contracts, versioning, authentication and authorisation, error handling, idempotency, resilience, observability and backward compatibility.
* **Database Engineering** Strong relational database fundamentals, including data modelling, SQL, transactions, indexing, query optimisation and performance troubleshooting. Experience with PostgreSQL and/or Oracle is preferred, but strong experience with comparable enterprise relational databases is acceptable.
* **Systems Design & Architecture** Able to design scalable, resilient and secure distributed systems, and reason about service boundaries, integration patterns, synchronous versus asynchronous processing, caching, failure handling, high availability and performance.
* **Security Engineering Fundamentals** Strong understanding of secure application development, particularly API security, authentication and authorisation, encryption, secrets management, dependency vulnerabilities and common application/API security risks such as the OWASP Top 10.
* **Engineering Quality & Testing** Strong understanding of automated testing across unit, integration, contract and end-to-end levels, with the ability to establish appropriate quality controls within CI/CD pipelines.
* **DevOps & Production Engineering** Practical experience with CI/CD, containers, deployment automation, monitoring, logging and troubleshooting production services. Able to design software with operability and production resilience in mind.
* **AI-Augmented Engineering & Problem Solving** Able to use AI-assisted engineering tools effectively for software development, analysis, troubleshooting, testing and documentation. Understands prompt and context engineering sufficiently to provide AI tools with the right code, architecture, constraints and engineering context, while critically validating their output.
* **Critical Technical Thinking** Able to challenge assumptions, work through ambiguous technical problems, evaluate alternative approaches and make sound engineering decisions based on evidence, risk and trade-offs.

**Additional Skills**
---------------------

**Other Technical Skills**

* Event-driven and asynchronous architectures, messaging and integration patterns
* Containerisation and Kubernetes
* Cloud-native engineering
* Observability and application performance management
* Network fundamentals, particularly HTTP/TLS, DNS, proxies, load balancing and connectivity troubleshooting
* Web and application security

**Human Skills**

* Sets engineering direction, raises technical standards, reviews designs and code, mentors engineers, and remains sufficiently hands-on to guide teams through complex engineering problems.
* Grows Self (Everyone)
* Continuously develops engineering and leadership capability.
* Grows Others (People Leaders)
* Coaches engineers, builds capability and creates strong engineering ownership within the team.
* Grows Bank (Enterprise Leaders)
* Makes technology decisions with an enterprise perspective, balancing delivery, sustainability, security, risk and reuse.

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

* **Never settle,** continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well

**What we offer**

* **A continuous learning culture** to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.

title: Engineer/Senior Engineer - Building Automation, ELV/ICT
description:
The Team:

Cundall is an award-winning global, multi-disciplinary consultancy with a strong and growing presence across the Asia-Pacific region. Our leadership in sustainable business was recognized when Cundall received the World Green Building Council’s 2020 Business Leadership in Sustainability Award for the APAC region, reflecting our commitment to embedding sustainability into the way we work and the outcomes we deliver for the built environment.

Sustainability underpins everything we do. We empower our people to drive positive change, decarbonize the built environment and create energy-efficient, resilient and climate-responsive buildings and communities.

Our Building Services team delivers integrated, resilient and technology-led solutions for complex buildings and infrastructure. Our Building Automation, ELV and ICT specialists work across commercial, mission-critical, healthcare, hospitality and mixed-use developments, combining controls and systems-integration expertise with a practical understanding of construction, commissioning and building operations.

The Role:

This is an excellent opportunity for a Building Automation and ELV/ICT Engineer or Senior Engineer to join our Chennai office and contribute to projects across India, the Middle East and the wider Asia-Pacific region.

We are seeking an engineer with strong consultancy design experience in Building Management Systems (BMS), building automation and controls, supported by capability in Extra-Low Voltage (ELV), Information and Communications Technology (ICT) and electronic security systems.

The successful candidate will lead or develop coordinated controls and ELV designs from concept through construction and commissioning for commercial buildings, data centres and other complex facilities.

The role requires confident engagement with clients, architects, MEP engineers, contractors, controls specialists, system integrators and vendors, together with sound engineering judgement and strong technical documentation, coordination and communication skills.

Key Responsibilities:

* Develop Building Management System and building automation designs, including controls philosophies, points schedules, sequences of operation, system architectures, network topologies, plant schematics, control-panel requirements, integration matrices and performance specifications.
* Design and coordinate controls for HVAC, central utility plants, electrical monitoring, energy metering, lighting and other building systems, with particular emphasis on mission-critical facilities and data centres.
* Define interfaces and data exchange between BMS, SCADA, EPMS, fire alarm, security, lighting control, lifts, packaged plant and other third-party systems using appropriate open protocols.
* Design ELV and ICT systems, including fire detection and alarm, voice evacuation/public address, CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, structured cabling, LAN/Wi-Fi infrastructure, intercom, and other specialist systems as applicable.
* Prepare design criteria, layouts, schematics, calculations, technical specifications, equipment schedules, bills of quantities, cost inputs and tender documentation.
* Coordinate automation and ELV requirements with architectural, electrical, mechanical, fire-and-life-safety, security, IT and structural disciplines, including sensors, control devices, panels, power supplies, containment, network infrastructure and equipment-space requirements.
* Review vendor submissions, shop drawings, control schematics, software and graphics proposals, material submittals, method statements and technical deviations for compliance with the design intent and project requirements.
* Support tender evaluations, value engineering, technical clarifications and assessments of controls contractors, OEMs and system integrators.
* Contribute to BIM-led coordination and work effectively with Revit and CAD technicians to deliver accurate, coordinated drawings and models.
* Manage assigned deliverables, budgets and programmes across multiple projects while maintaining Cundall’s quality and safety expectations.

  
The Skills:

Qualifications and Experience:

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Instrumentation, Controls, Mechatronics, Telecommunications or a related engineering discipline.
* Typically 4–8 years of relevant consultancy or design experience for Engineer/Senior Engineer level, with demonstrable building automation or BMS experience; candidates with stronger leadership experience may be considered for a more senior position.
* Proven experience developing BMS controls philosophies, points schedules, sequences of operation, system architectures, integration requirements and commissioning documentation is essential.
* Experience producing coordinated Building Automation and ELV/ICT designs for commercial, data centre, healthcare, hospitality, industrial or large infrastructure projects.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD is essential; working knowledge of Revit, Navisworks and BIM coordination workflows is strongly preferred.
* Ability to develop technical specifications, BOQs, design reports, calculations, schematics and tender packages with limited supervision.
* Experience coordinating with clients, architects, MEP consultants, contractors, OEMs, controls specialists and system integrators.
* Familiarity with applicable Indian codes and approvals, including NBC requirements, relevant BIS/IS standards and local fire-authority expectations, together with commonly used international standards.

**Job Summary**
---------------

A Data Analyst interprets data and helps turn it into information that enables or improves a business process, thus affecting business decisions. Data Analysts gather information from various sources and interpret patterns and trends to make it digestible for others. They must have strong analytical skills, but above all have a burning curiosity to understand, and make sense of, data. They will work closely with:
  
• Data Managers, who define the team's business requirements, objectives, strategy and priorities
  
• Data Engineers, who design and implement the processes by which data is collected and generated
  
• Data Quality Analysts, who define data quality control requirements and oversee these on a day to day basis to ensure constant system health
  
• Upstream data teams, who provide the data that the analyst is sourcing
  
• Downstream Process Owners, who depend on the data to perform their business function
  
Data Analysts spend much of their time working with stakeholders to define data requirements, data transformation logic and supporting the delivery of these requirements from start to finish. They are experts in profiling data to understand its contents and will also have a working understanding of the business process or product that generated it in the first place. Data Analysts are the entry point to the FCC Data Team for most external stakeholders and as such will have a broad, but still detailed, understanding of all the data available and constantly seek opportunities for innovation and expansion. They are the primary liaison between up- and downstream teams

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Responsibilities for FCC Data Analysts:**  
• Define clear, concise and detailed business requirements for FCC Data that clearly document the data elements and formats that are needed, outline detailed transformation expectations and list the critical data elements that will enable downstream processes to operate effectively
  
• Create and maintain documentation that articulates the process by which data is extracted, transformed and loaded in FCC that can be shared and understood by others
  
• Work with downstream FCC business process owners to constantly improve, refine and expand the datasets to improve the quality and effectiveness of those processes, as well as help them to make sense of the data, providing training where required, and derive meaningful BI / MI
  
• Conduct detailed analysis of upstream changes that impact FCC data – for example the introduction of a new products – to ensure that requirements remain up to date and define any new ones as necessary
  
• Identify areas of overlap or data gaps that can lead to increased value, either by eliminating redundant processes or expanding existing data models
  
• Produce accurate and insightful dashboards and reports detailing the health, content and insights available from the data, making that actionable for stakeholders and meaningful for management decision making

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Must-have Skills**  
• SQL Querying skills
  
• Payments knowledge of Swift network and ISO 20022
  
• Banking domain knowledge
  
**Other Skills**  
• AML knowledge
  
• Interpersonal skills
  
• Stakeholder Management

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Skills and Eligibility**  
• Minimum 10+ years of professional experience as business change analyst in financial markets related banking products
  
• Degree (or similar) in Engineering and MBA is preferred
  
• A strong understanding of Cash Management systems or Payment Systems or Core Banking functionality / data flows – will be desired
  
• Good understanding of systems and data flows in Financial Crime Compliance / Anti Money Laundering etc. will be an added advantage
  
• Able to seamlessly move and translate between detailed functional data requirements and non-technical general terms
  
• The ability to write clear, concise and detailed business requirements that can be understood by data engineers and developers as well as business stakeholders
  
• Strong understanding of Cash Management systems or Payment Systems or Core Banking functionality / data flows – will be desired
  
• Competence with data profiling tools and methodologies (SQL at a minimum), with a preference for dedicated and sophisticated tools such as Paxata or Tableau
  
• Familiar with data documentation, delivery workflow and defect tracking tools – JIRA and Confluence in particular
  
• Demonstrated experience in handling and understanding large datasets and relational databases
  
• Experience in analytical roles with a large technical component, although not necessarily from a purely data perspective (e.g. they may have prior working knowledge of upstream or downstream processes that is relevant from a data perspective)
  
• Evidenced ability to execute and enhance a process to maintain data transformation requirements over time and constantly seek to improve these
  
• High quality written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to focus on multiple initiatives and data subjects (types of data or varying sources of data) at the same time
  
• Evidence a very strong attention to detail, reflecting the very low tolerance for error in FCC data

We are committed to **technological excellence** and will continue to **pioneer innovative services** as we grow responsibly in the coming years. **Join us** and be a part of a strategic team that **moves the world**.

**Role Summary:**

The Engineer III is an experienced individual contributor who independently designs, develops, implements, and supports secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable enterprise integration solutions. The role combines strong EDI and API engineering capabilities with technical ownership across middleware, messaging, file-based interfaces, automation, modernization, and platform services. The Engineer III consistently delivers high-quality work, contributes to technical decisions and design reviews, guides peers and junior engineers, and helps shape solutions across systems, services, platforms, and products within the assigned domain.

Working across engineering teams and business stakeholders, the Engineer III drives complex integration delivery, strengthens operational resilience, improves code quality and performance, promotes engineering standards, and translates business and customer needs into effective technical solutions. The role also contributes through mentoring, knowledge sharing, documentation, continuous improvement, and portfolio or department-level initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Software, API, and Platform Development**

* Design, develop, configure, test, implement, and support application components, services, APIs, EDI translations, middleware integrations, and platform capabilities.
* Independently develop and maintain REST-based APIs, web services, system interfaces, reusable components, and automation utilities using established engineering standards and architectural patterns.
* Perform thorough self-reviews and code reviews, provide actionable feedback to peers and junior engineers, and improve the maintainability, reliability, security, and performance of solutions.
* Develop and maintain automated testing strategies, including unit, integration, API, and end-to-end test coverage to improve software quality and reliability
* Optimize complex code, mapping logic, services, and integration flows to reduce processing time, resource usage, defects, and repeated implementation effort.
* Use approved AI-assisted development tools responsibly to support coding, testing, documentation, defect detection, and technical analysis while maintaining established quality and security standards.

**EDI and Enterprise Integration Delivery**

* Design, develop, and support enterprise integrations across ANSI X12, EDIFACT, XML, JSON, CSV, flat files, APIs, middleware, messaging, event-driven communication, and managed file-transfer patterns.
* Own complex EDI and integration projects, including requirement interpretation, mapping and transformation logic, interface design, validation, testing, implementation, deployment, and post-production support.
* Analyze input and output data, envelopes, acknowledgements, partner configurations, routes, canonical structures, and downstream system behavior to confirm accuracy, completeness, and expected processing.
* Troubleshoot complex applications, API, middleware, mapping, dataflow, transactions, communication, and performance issues by isolating root causes and implementing sustainable solutions.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and downstream impacts early, and recommend mitigation approaches for complex or cross-system changes.
* Contribute reusable integration patterns, utilities, templates, and documentation that improve quality and consistency, acceleratetime to market, and strengthen team effectiveness.

**API Engineering and Modernization**

* Design, consume, test, secure, document, and support REST APIs and related system interfaces, including API contracts, request and response structures, validation, error handling, and versioning considerations.
* Contribute to API enablement that complements EDI capabilities and supports modern, reusable, and self-service integration experiences where appropriate.
* Apply microservices, messaging, event-driven, distributed system, and domain-driven design concepts to assign solutions when applicable.
* Contribute to application modernization initiatives, including migration from legacy platforms to modern architecture and engineering practices.
* Collaborate with platform, architecture, security, product, and adjacent engineering teams to align API and integration solutions with enterprise patterns and strategic objectives.

**Technical Design and Architecture**

* Lead or actively contribute to technical design for systems of significant size and near- to mid-term business impact.
* Participate actively in technical design reviews, provide feedback on other designs, incorporate feedback, and help shape technical decisions of significant complexity, ensuring alignment with Engineering Principles and architectural standards.
* Apply Engineering Principles and approved architectural patterns to improve modularity, interoperability, reliability, scalability, maintainability, security, and observability.
* Evaluate system dependencies, design tradeoffs, operational impacts, failure modes, and downstream effects when developing or changing solutions.
* Document technical designs, API contracts, data mappings, implementation decisions, test evidence, deployment details, operational procedures, and support findings.

**Engineering Practices and Operational Excellence**

* Own technical decisions for daily work and ensure conformity to Engineering Principles, coding standards, development processes, security practices, and deployment procedures.
* Actively enable Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery through automated builds, testing, quality checks, and deployment practices.
* Implement and maintain monitoring, observability, telemetry, logging, alerting, and operational automation capabilities to improve system resilience and operational excellence**.**
* Participate in production support and on-call rotations; guide operational resilience for systems contributed to and engage effectively in incident management and response.
* Contribute to operational and security automation and identify recurring support or delivery activities that can be simplified or automated.
* Continuously improve code quality, system performance, delivery efficiency, and customer experience through root-cause analysis and preventive action.

  
**Qualifications**

**Minimum Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 8+ years of professional experience in software development, application integration, platform support, API development, middleware, or related engineering discipline
* Progressive experience in software development, enterprise application integration, API development, EDI, middleware, platform engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

**Technical Skills and Knowledge**

description:
IT Engineer / Digital Technology & Media Executive

**Company:** EXPROOFTECH

1. About the Role

EXPROOFTECH is looking for an active, technology-oriented and multi-skilled **IT Engineer** to manage the company's IT infrastructure, networking, website development, digital marketing tools, content creation, multimedia editing, and AI-based productivity applications.

The candidate should have a combination of IT administration skills, digital communication capabilities, creative thinking, and practical knowledge of modern AI tools, particularly **Claude AI**.

title: Manager - Projects & Qs
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION: MANAGER – PROJECTS & QS**

**Position Vacant**

Manager – Projects & QS

**Organization Name**

Covestays Pvt Ltd (Cove Offices)

**Reports To**

Management

**Education**

* B.E. / B.Tech – Civil (preferred), Electrical or Mechanical.
* Diploma in Engineering with strong relevant execution and QS experience will also be considered.
* Certification in Quantity Surveying (RICS / IIQS), Project Management (PMP) or Construction Management (NICMAR) is a plus.

**Job Description / Responsibilities**

An engineer who started in site execution and has moved onto a project management track, with strong quantity surveying ability.

The role spans budgeting, planning, estimation, billing and quality across Cove’s fit-out and modification projects.

This is a hands-on role – the person must be able to produce a BOQ from a drawing, check a contractor’s bill and oversee execution of interior fit-out projects.

**Budgeting & Estimation**

* Prepare project budgets for new centres, client interior modifications and repair or upgrade works.
* Quantity take-off from architectural and MEP drawings; prepare detailed BOQs covering civil, interiors, electrical, HVAC, fire fighting, plumbing, IT and networking, and access control.
* Rate analysis and benchmarking against prevailing Chennai and Bangalore market rates; build and maintain an internal rate library.
* Develop cost per seat and cost per sq.ft. benchmarks by centre and by scope, and provide fit-out cost inputs for client proposals and landlord negotiations.

**Planning & Scheduling**

* Prepare project schedules identifying the critical path and the activities that must run in sequence versus in parallel.
* Prepare procurement and material delivery schedules aligned to the construction programme.
* Track actual progress against baseline, flag slippage early and prepare recovery plans.
* Maintain look-ahead plans and daily and weekly progress reporting.

**Tendering & Procurement**

* Prepare tender documents, float RFQs and RFIs, and run pre-bid clarifications.
* Prepare technical and commercial comparative statements and recommend award.
* Draft work orders with unambiguous scope, rates, measurement basis, payment terms and timelines.
* Identify and develop new vendors and contractors across civil, MEP and specialist trades.

**Measurement, Billing & Certification**

* Carry out joint measurement at site and record measurements in the measurement book.
* Verify contractor RA bills against the BOQ, work order rates and actual site measurement, and certify for payment.
* Maintain deviation and variation statements with rate justification for non-BOQ and extra items.
* Reconcile free-issue and client-supplied material.
* Track advances, retention, recoveries, debit notes, and final bill settlement and closure.
* Coordinate with finance for release of payments against certification.

**QA / QC**

* Prepare and enforce inspection and test plans, stage-wise quality checklists and the material approval process.
* Check executed work against drawings, specifications and approved samples at each stage.
* Conduct pre-handover testing – electrical load and earthing, HVAC balancing and airflow, fire system testing, plumbing pressure testing, network certification and access control commissioning.
* Prepare and close snag lists; complete handover documentation including as-builts, warranties, O&M manuals and asset registers.

**Cost Control & Reporting**

* Track estimated versus actual cost line by line; maintain a variation register and flag overruns before they are incurred.
* Identify value-engineering opportunities and quantify the saving and the trade-off.
* Prepare monthly MIS on cost, schedule and quality across all live projects.
* Prepare decision notes and options analyses for management on technical and commercial matters.

**Technical Support to Management**

* Act as the technical point of contact for management – site inspections, technical assessment of prospective buildings, and assessment of landlord fit-out obligations and base-build condition.
* Scope, cost and advise on chargeability of client fit-out and modification requests.
* Prepare technical inputs for client agreements, scope schedules, snag and handover documents.
* Represent Cove in meetings with landlords, architects, consultants and contractors.

**Desired profile of the candidate**

* An execution engineer on a project management track, with strong quantity surveying skills. This is not a supervisory-only profile – the person must personally build budgets, check measurements and certify bills.
* Experience with a PMC, design-build contractor, IPC, developer, or a retail / flex-space rollout operator, handling commercial interior fit-out projects.
* Comfortable working across civil, electrical and MEP scopes rather than a single trade.
* Strong numerical discipline and documentation habits.
* Willing to travel across Chennai and Bangalore. Primary place of posting – Chennai / Bangalore.

**Desired work experience (in complete years)**

5 – 8 yrs, including at least 2 – 3 yrs of direct site execution.

**Compensation Offered (Salary Range)**

₹7.00L – ₹10.00L p.a.

**Competencies**

* Advanced MS Excel – mandatory
* MS Project or Primavera for scheduling.
* AutoCAD for drawing reading, measurement and markups.
* Standard methods of measurement – IS 1200 / CPWD norms; familiarity with SOR practice.
* Ability to read and coordinate civil, electrical, HVAC, fire fighting, plumbing and IT/networking drawings.
* Knowledge of commercial interior fit-out materials, systems and work methodologies.
* Clear written and verbal communication; ability to summarise and escalate to management concisely.
* Experience working across multiple sites and managing multiple contractors simultaneously.

**Must Have**

* Demonstrated bill verification and certification experience, with responsibility for the value certified.
* Ability to independently prepare a BOQ from a drawing set.
* Hands-on knowledge of civil, electrical and MEP works – not limited to one discipline.
* Languages: fluency in English conversational Tamil / Hindi / Kannada.

**Selection Process**

* Timed technical case study – project budget and BOQ, project plan, drawing list, testing and pre-opening checks, and risk assessment, against a given fit-out drawing and scope.
* Technical interview on measurement, billing and MEP coordination.
* Management interview.

**Location of posting**

Chennai / Bangalore

**Company Profile**

COVE is real estate for the rental economy. We offer innovative and hassle-free solutions to the problem of shared offices and rental residences in Indian cities. We offer custom-built solutions to short- and long-term renters without any unnecessary frills. Our centres lie in close vicinity to major industrial and technology parks and similar hubs of economic activity.

Cove operates around 5,000 workstation seats across multiple centres in Bangalore and Chennai.

At Cove, you will find a workplace that allows you to express your talents and skills. You will find an entrepreneurial culture that encourages you to take responsibility and learn by doing.

If real estate excites you, if you seek excellence in your work, if you like taking on responsibility and challenges, if you are the type that never settles for less, get in touch. We’d love to see how you could fit in.

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Industrial Automation and PLC Programming Lead
description:
Job ID
68986
Category
Manufacturing
Location
Chennai, India
Work Type
On\-site  

The Industrial Automation and PLC Programming Lead will serve as a technical subject\-matter expert for shop\-floor automation and controls systems supporting manufacturing operations and forward model programs.
This position combines hands\-on production support with long\-term technical standardization. The role will manage and prioritize automation\-related support requests, troubleshoot production\-impacting issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and serve as an escalation point for complex or recurring controls problems.
The position will also lead the development, documentation, and implementation of programming standards, reusable software libraries, naming conventions, controls templates, and engineering best practices. The role will work closely with manufacturing engineering, information technology, operational technology, equipment suppliers, system integrators, and plant support teams to ensure that automation solutions are reliable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with applicable organizational and Original Equipment Manufacturer standards.
**Production and Technical Support**
* Manage and prioritize technical support requests involving PLCs, HMIs, MES interfaces, robotics, and industrial connectivity systems.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and programming support for production\-impacting controls and automation issues.
* Diagnose PLC logic, HMI application, communication, robotics, and shop\-floor system failures.
* Perform structured root\-cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Act as an escalation point for complex, recurring, or high\-impact technical issues.
* Coordinate with manufacturing, maintenance, controls engineering, information technology, operational technology, and supplier teams during issue resolution.
* Maintain accurate records of incidents, technical findings, implemented solutions, and lessons learned.
* Define and monitor appropriate service\-level measures and key performance indicators for issue response, resolution, system reliability, and recurring failures.

**Controls Standards and Standardization**
* Develop, document, implement, and maintain PLC and HMI programming standards.
* Establish consistent naming conventions, program structures, alarm strategies, diagnostic methods, and documentation requirements.
* Develop reusable logic modules, Add\-On Instructions, function blocks, HMI objects, templates, and software libraries.
* Lead the migration or alignment of legacy controls programs with approved standards and reusable architectures.
* Conduct technical design reviews and periodic audits to assess compliance with established controls standards.
* Identify opportunities to reduce engineering effort, improve maintainability, and increase consistency across equipment and manufacturing lines.
* Establish appropriate software backup, change\-management, release\-management, and version\-control practices for PLC, HMI, and robot programs.
* Maintain standard technical documents, implementation guidelines, checklists, and validation procedures.
* Support the structured rollout and adoption of new controls standards across relevant plants, programs, or production lines.

**PLC and HMI Engineering**
* Develop, modify, debug, validate, and support PLC applications using platforms such as Allen\-Bradley Studio 5000, Siemens TIA Portal, or equivalent industrial controls platforms.
* Develop and maintain HMI applications using platforms such as FactoryTalk View, Siemens WinCC, or equivalent technologies.
* Review and optimize PLC program architecture, sequencing, interlocks, alarms, fault handling, and equipment diagnostics.
* Support commissioning, production launch, equipment integration, and continuous\-improvement activities.
* Ensure that controls programs are appropriately documented, tested, backed up, and maintained.
* Support the implementation of effective equipment recovery, troubleshooting, and diagnostic features.

**Manufacturing Execution System Integration**
* Support and troubleshoot interfaces between manufacturing equipment, PLCs, supervisory systems, and Manufacturing Execution Systems.
* Investigate data\-quality, equipment\-status, production\-tracking, and system\-integration issues.
* Support industrial data exchange using technologies such as Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture, commonly known as OPC UA.
* Collaborate with MES and information technology teams to maintain reliable communication between shop\-floor controls and manufacturing applications.
* Help ensure the accuracy, availability, and integrity of manufacturing data.

**Industrial Connectivity and IIoT**
* Support the implementation and troubleshooting of Message Queuing Telemetry Transport, or MQTT, and other industrial data communication solutions.
* Support Industrial Internet of Things gateways, edge devices, sensors, communication brokers, and associated data pipelines.
* Develop or maintain standard configurations for industrial connectivity solutions.
* Support technologies such as Sparkplug B, Ignition, Kepware, or equivalent industrial integration platforms where applicable.
* Work with information technology and operational technology teams to ensure industrial connectivity solutions meet applicable networking, cybersecurity, reliability, and data\-governance requirements.
* Support the availability of manufacturing data for approved monitoring, reporting, and analytical applications.

**Robotics Support**
* Support troubleshooting, program review, and optimization for industrial robotic systems.
* Work with robot platforms such as FANUC, ABB, or equivalent industrial robotics technologies.
* Coordinate with controls engineers, equipment suppliers, integrators, and production teams to resolve robot\-related manufacturing issues.
* Support robot program backup, change control, documentation, and recovery procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve robot reliability, cycle performance, diagnostics, and maintainability.

**Forward Model Program Support**
* Support automation planning, technical reviews, equipment integration, commissioning, and production launch activities for forward model programs.
* Review supplier and system\-integrator controls designs for compliance with approved technical standards.
* Participate in design reviews, software reviews, equipment acceptance activities, and launch\-readiness assessments.
* Identify automation risks and recommend appropriate technical countermeasures.
* Capture lessons learned from launches and production support activities and incorporate them into future standards and program requirements.

**Technical Leadership and Documentation**
* Serve as a technical subject\-matter expert for controls and industrial automation.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers, technicians, manufacturing teams, and support personnel.
* Create standard operating procedures, technical specifications, troubleshooting guides, training materials, and engineering standards.
* Facilitate technical reviews, problem\-solving sessions, and knowledge\-sharing activities.
* Communicate technical risks, recommendations, issue status, and implementation plans clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Promote continuous improvement, technical discipline, knowledge sharing, and the consistent application of engineering standards.

**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* An equivalent combination of relevant education and significant industrial automation experience may be considered, subject to organizational policy.

**Required Experience**
* Approximately 6 to 10 years of relevant experience in industrial automation, controls engineering, PLC programming, or manufacturing systems.
* Strong hands\-on experience developing, troubleshooting, and maintaining PLC applications.
* Experience developing or supporting industrial HMI applications.
* Experience troubleshooting production equipment and resolving manufacturing automation issues.
* Experience performing root\-cause analysis and implementing permanent corrective actions.
* Experience documenting controls standards, technical procedures, or engineering best practices.
* Experience collaborating with manufacturing, maintenance, engineering, information technology, suppliers, or system integrators.

**Required Technical Knowledge**
* Strong knowledge of PLC programming principles, industrial controls architecture, sequencing, interlocks, alarms, and equipment diagnostics.
* Experience with at least one major PLC platform, such as:
* Allen\-Bradley ControlLogix or CompactLogix using Studio 5000
* Siemens SIMATIC using TIA Portal
* An equivalent industrial PLC platform
* Experience with HMI development using FactoryTalk View, Siemens WinCC, or an equivalent platform.
* Working knowledge of industrial communication systems and protocols.
* Understanding of industrial Ethernet and shop\-floor network fundamentals.
* Ability to read and interpret controls documentation, electrical drawings, network architecture diagrams, and equipment specifications.
* Strong technical documentation and structured problem\-solving skills.
